​What does it mean to work at Armstrong?

It means being immersed in a supportive culture that recognizes you as a key player in Armstrong's future. We are a large company with a local feel, where you will get to know and collaborate with leadership and your colleagues across the company.

By joining us, you'll have the opportunity to make the most of your potential. Alongside a competitive remuneration package, you will receive:

A benefits package including: medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k match, long-term disability coverage, vacation and sick time, product discount programs and many more.
Personal development to grow your career with us based on your strengths and interests.
A working culture that balances individual achievement with teamwork and collaboration. We draw on each other's strengths and allow for different work styles to build engagement and satisfaction to deliver results.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Energy Savings Ceilings, we're seeking an East Regional Energy Savings Customer Success Manager who will support the execution of Energy Saving Ceilings (ESC) growth within a defined geography. This role serves as the regional concierge for customers and sales teams, driving customers through the decision funnel and ensuring a smooth, informed path to “yes.” This role combines customer advocacy, market intelligence, and commercial execution.

This is a hands-on execution role, focused on working with Architects & Designers (A&D), contractors, subcontractors, and distributors. The role partners closely with regional sales to identify opportunities, monitor active opportunities, remove barriers, and help convert interest into orders.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and persistent - someone who enjoys working directly with customers, coordinating across teams, and keeping projects moving.

What You’ll Do

Customer & Project Execution

  • Serve as the regional customer concierge — identify what customers need to move forward and coordinate internal resources to deliver it.
  • Support existing customer groups (A&D, contractors, subcontractors, distributors) throughout design and project development.
  • Monitor key regional projects and opportunity progress to ensure timely follow-up and engagement.
  • Help remove obstacles that may delay customer decisions or project advancement.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce (SFDC) and support sales enablement efforts.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve the customer journey and drive measurable conversion outcomes.

Sales Partnership

  • Partner closely with regional sales teams to identify opportunities, align on priorities, project status, and next actions.
  • Support customer meetings, follow-ups, and information requests that help move projects toward specification and order.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and customer activity in Salesforce (SFDC).

Customer Insight & Feedback

  • Capture and share Voice of Customer (VOC) insights, including common questions, barriers, and competitive dynamics.
  • Identify patterns in regional activity and elevate insights to the broader ESC team.

Coordination & Cross-Functional Support

  • Coordinate with technical, product, incentives, and operations teams to ensure customers receive timely and accurate information.
  • Support regional training, events, or customer engagement activities as needed.
  • Help improve execution processes that enhance the overall customer experience.

What will make you successful

  • Working knowledge and experience in construction, contracting, distribution, specification sales, commercial building products, and knowledge of market segments, customers, and distribution channels.
  • Experience working in or supporting the design and construction ecosystem (A&D, contractor, distributor, or building products environment) preferred.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Excellent communication and follow-through.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with field sales and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience in customer success, sales support, project coordination, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of outside sales experience working with architects, distributors, or owners.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • High school diploma/GED required.

What You Bring

  • Positive Energy: You bring enthusiasm and optimism to customer and team interactions.
  • Relentless Persistence: You follow through and keep projects moving until issues are resolved.
  • Curiosity: You ask questions to understand customer needs and challenges.
  • Adaptability: You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
  • Collaboration: You partner effectively with sales and internal teams to deliver strong customer outcomes.

Why should you join Armstrong World Industries?

Armstrong World Industries (AWI) is an Americas leader in the design and manufacture of innovative interior and exterior architectural applications including ceilings, specialty walls and exterior metal solutions. With approximately $1.4 billion in revenue, AWI has about 3,700 employees and a manufacturing network of 21 facilities in North America.

At home, at work, in healthcare facilities, classrooms, stores, or restaurants, we offer interior solutions that help to enhance comfort, save time, improve building efficiency and overall performance, and create beautiful spaces.

For more than 160 years, we have built our business on trust and integrity. It set us apart then, and it sets us apart now, along with our ability to collaborate with and innovate for the people we're here to serve - our customers, our shareholders, our communities and our employees.

We are committed to developing new and sustainable architectural solutions, with design and performance possibilities that make a positive difference in spaces where we live, work, learn, heal and play. It's an exciting, rewarding business to be in, and we're committed to continue to grow and prosper for the benefit of all of our stakeholders. We hope you join us.

Our Sustainability Ambition

"Bringing our Purpose to Life" - lead a transformation in the design and building of spaces fit for today and tomorrow.

We are committed to:

  • Engaging a diverse, purpose-driven workforce;
  • Transforming buildings from structures that shelter into structures that serve and preserve the health and well-being of people and planet;
  • Pursuing sustainable, innovative solutions for spaces where we live, work, learn heal and play;
  • Being a catalyst for change with all of our stakeholders; and
  • Making a positive difference in the environments and communities we impact.

About the location (Lancaster PA)

Lancaster, PA. A great central location in South Central Pennsylvania, Lancaster is ideally situated for easy access to major metropolitan cities such as Philadelphia, Baltimore, Washington DC, and New York City. Lancaster offers a vibrant arts and entertainment community with wonderful historic sites, B&Bs, museums, great shopping, entertainment venues and restaurants.

Armstrong is committed to engaging a diverse, purpose-driven workforce. As part of our dedication to diversity, AWI is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard for race, sex, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at by email at AWI talent acquisition and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

Come and build your future with us and apply today!

jobs.description:
Wie bringt HORNBACH neue Produkte in Rekordzeit in den Webshop und in seine Märkte? Zur Reduzierung der Durchlaufzeiten arbeitet unser IT-Team Einkauf & Stammdaten mit großem Freiraum und viel Humor an den besten Lösungen für unsere Datenschnittstellen zu unseren Lieferanten. Für unsere internen Berater eine echte Herausforderung – und unsere Leidenschaft.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwickeln: AlsSTEP Entwickler / Consultant (gn) gestaltest Du die Weiterentwicklung unserer Master-Data-Management-Landschaft aktiv mit, von der Idee über die Umsetzung bis zum Betrieb nach dem Motto: „You build it, you run it.“
  • Beraten: Du verstehst Dich als Brücke zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung und berätst unsere Fachbereiche bei der Optimierung und Digitalisierung ihrer Prozesse.
  • Sichern: Im Rahmen des 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Supports analysierst Du komplexe Fragestellungen und stellst den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer Systeme sicher.
  • Verbessern: Mit Deinem agilen Mindset unterstützt Du kurze Entwicklungszyklen und bringst eigene Ideen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung ein.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Leidenschaft: Wichtiger als Dein Studiengang oder Deine Ausbildung ist uns Deine Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung und innovative IT-Lösungen.
  • Know-how: Du verfügst idealerweise über Erfahrung mit STEP (Stibo Systems) oder vergleichbaren Master-Data-Management-Lösungen. Erfahrung mit Produktdatenmanagement (PIM) oder Einkaufssystemen sind ein Plus.
  • Technologien: Du besitzt Kenntnisse in modernen Webtechnologien wie JavaScript, HTML, XML und interessierst Dich für systemübergreifende Integrationen und komplexe Datenprozesse.
  • Kommunikation: Du bewegst Dich sicher zwischen Fachbereich und IT und vermittelst auch komplexe Themen verständlich.
  • Mindset: Clean Code, Ownership, Teamwork und agile Arbeitsweisen sind für Dich keine Buzzwords, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen:

  • Hänge Deine Krawatte an den Nagel: Es erwartet Dich eine offene Arbeitsatmosphäre durch flache Hierarchien und tolle Kolleginnen und Kollegen in einem bodenständigen Familienunternehmen.
  • Raum für private Projekte: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten inkl. Zeiterfassung und einem modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz sowie der Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice (mobiles Arbeiten) legen wir das Fundament für die optimale Vereinbarkeit von Arbeit und Privatleben.
  • Arbeitszeit nach Maß: Du kannst Deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel und passend zur individuellen Lebenssituation planen.
  • Mit uns wachsen: Mit maßgeschneiderten Fort- und Weiterbildungen fördern wir Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
  • Wir bauen auf Dich: Mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag sowie einem attraktiven Gehaltspaket inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.
  • Unsere Anerkennung für Dein Herzblut: HORNBACH-Rente, Jobrad, Gutscheinkarte, HORNBACH-Mastercard, Deutschlandticket, Belegschaftsaktien und viele weitere Zusatzleistungen (alle Infos unter ).

Wir sind gespannt darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Sende uns bitte Deinen Lebenslauf, Deine aktuellen Zeugnisse und Gehaltsvorstellungen. Über ein Motivationsschreiben freuen wir uns immer, für eine Bewerbung bei uns ist dies aber kein Muss.

jobs.description:
Values & Innovation

At Under Armour, we are committed to empowering those who strive for more, and the company's values - Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes and Stand for Equality - serve as both a roadmap for our teams and the qualities expected of every teammate.

Our Values define and unite us, the beliefs that are the red thread that connects everyone at Under Armour. Our values are rallying cries, reminding us why we're here, and fueling everything we do.

Our pursuit of better begins with innovation and with our team's mission of being the best. With us, you get the freedom to go further - no matter your role. That means developing, delivering, and selling the state-of-the-art products and digital tools that make top performers even better.

If you are a current Under Armour teammate, apply to this position on the Internal Career Site Here.

Purpose of Role

The Lead Product Manager - Decide, will focus on driving decision clarity and enabling conversion across the early stages of the digital journey. This role is responsible for building and optimizing web experiences that help consumers confidently evaluate products and progress toward purchase, strengthening the connection between product discovery and conversion.

In this role, you will partner closely with product, design, engineering, analytics, merchandising, and marketing teams to deliver seamless, data-driven experiences that improve customer engagement, product understanding, and progression through the shopping journey. You will play a critical role in accelerating digital growth by enhancing how consumers interact with products and move toward conversion within the ecommerce ecosystem.

Your Impact

  • Own and shape the Decide web roadmap from ideation through post-launch optimization, balancing long-term platform investments with a test-and-learn approach that drives measurable improvements in customer decision-making and purchase consideration.
  • Drive consumer confidence and decision clarity by shaping how product information and storytelling come together on-site — creating the conditions for customers to move forward with purchase intent.
  • Define the success metrics for the Decide experience, using qualitative and quantitative data and competitive benchmarks to surface opportunities and measure the impact of what ships.
  • Influence priorities and drive alignment across global cross-functional partners — ensuring initiatives are well-sequenced, clearly scoped, and connected to broader business outcomes.
  • Stay ahead of emerging ecommerce patterns, AI-driven capabilities, and digital experience trends — identifying opportunities to differentiate the product evaluation experience before they become table stakes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with typically 5 years of relevant experience, OR Master's degree with typically 3 years of relevant experience, OR Typically 9 years of relevant work experience without degree
  • Expertise in using data to drive product decisions and measure impact, with experience in A/B testing, user research, and the ability to self-serve insights and build dashboards using analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics and Datadog.
  • Proven ability to influence priorities and drive alignment across global cross-functional partners, navigating complex stakeholder environments and delivering successful product outcomes across teams and time zones.
  • Ability to craft a compelling product narrative that clearly articulates project motivation, goals, and success pathways — comfortable framing problems and solutions logically and persuasively in both written and verbal communication, including executive-level audiences.
  • Experience working in agile environments with a strong command of the full product lifecycle from ideation through post-launch iteration, including ownership of roadmap delivery and continuous optimization.

Workplace Location

  • Location: Home Office
  • Work Schedule: Fully Remote
  • Sponsorship Eligibility: UA does not offer sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based work authorization for this position at this time.

Relocation

  • No relocation provided

Base Compensation

$125,000.00-$165,000.00 USD

Most new hires fall within this range and have the opportunity to earn more over time. Initial placement within the salary range, however, is based on an individual's relevant knowledge, skills and experience for the position. UA is committed to helping our teammates succeed and advance in their careers. Base salary is only one component of our competitive Total Rewards package.

Benefits & Perks

  • Paid "UA Give Back" Volunteer Days: Work alongside your team to support initiatives in your local community
  • Under Armour Merchandise Discounts
  • Competitive 401(k) plan matching
  • Maternity and Parental Leave for eligible and FMLA-eligible teammates
  • Health & fitness benefits, discounts and resources- We offer teammates across the country programs to promote physical activity and overall well-being

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Under Armour, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, family or paternal status and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Under Armour seeks to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people representing a wide variety of backgrounds and perspectives. jobs.description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This position is US-based and can work onsite or hybrid from one of our offices or fully remote.
Travel: Up to 30%, domestic and international
Job ID: 1779

The Role:

We are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to design how networks become quantum-safe — for the largest network operators, enterprises, and government agencies in the world.

Today's networks are secured with cryptography that a cryptographically relevant quantum computer will break. Every operator and enterprise will have to inventory their cryptography, make it agile, migrate to post-quantum algorithms, and in the highest-assurance segments complement that with quantum-safe key distribution. Almost nobody knows yet what that architecture actually looks like. That is the problem you will solve — first with customers, on real networks, and then as reusable architectures that shape what IonQ builds.

This role sits deliberately in two places. About half your time is customer-facing: in collaboration with our GTM colleagues, you’ll be leading architecture discussions, designing quantum-safe target architectures and migration paths, running proofs of concept and interoperability tests, and supporting complex pursuits as the technical authority. The other half is design authority, standards work, and providing thought leadership internally and externally: turning what you learn in the field into reference architectures, migration playbooks, standards, whitepapers, blogs, and product requirements that our engineering and product teams build against.

You are equally comfortable in a firewall design review as you are in a discussion about hybrid key exchange and crypto-agility. You can explain to a CISO why their crypto inventory is the hard part, and to a network engineer exactly which IPsec algorithms to use and where they could insert external key material in order to become quantum-safe.

This is not a software architecture role — you will not own a codebase (it’s a plus if you can do some scripting). It is an architecture and customer role: you own designs, decisions, and the technical credibility of IonQ's quantum-safe networking story.

Responsibilities:

  • Design quantum-safe target architectures and migration paths for customer networks — spanning WAN and transport, data center and campus, segmentation and access control, key management, and the crypto that underpins all of it.
  • Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with network, security, and infrastructure teams. Assess the current state, identify where cryptography is embedded and where it is brittle, and build a migration plan the customer can actually execute.
  • Own the technical thread in complex pursuits: architecture proposals, RFI/RFP responses, security and compliance questions, competitive positioning, and objection handling — in partnership with Sales.
  • In collaboration with the Sales Engineers, design and run proofs of concept, interoperability tests, and pilots — including PQC and hybrid key exchange in production-representative network environments and, where relevant, QKD-integrated links — together with our engineering teams and customer staff.
  • Translate field learning into reusable reference architectures, migration playbooks, interoperability matrices, and design guides that scale beyond the deals you personally work.
  • Serve as the customer's voice in the product process. Bring architectural constraints, integration gaps, and roadmap requirements to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to be actionable, and hold us to them.
  • Track how the standards and threat landscape actually move and contribute to them — NIST PQC standards and migration guidance, protocol work in the IETF, national and sector-specific mandates and deadlines — and keep our architectures and guidance ahead of it.
  • Partner with Marketing, Corporate Communications, and GTM to build IonQ's technical presence in the networking and security community: talks, papers, blogs, standards bodies, and industry events.
  • Raise the technical bar around you — architecture reviews, mentoring, and the design patterns the rest of the team reuses.

Requirements:

  • 15+ years designing and securing enterprise and/or service provider networks, in a solutions architecture, network architecture, security architecture, or senior customer-facing engineering capacity.
  • Deep (hands-on) knowledge of how networks are built and secured today: routing and switching, IP transport, network segmentation, firewall and access control design, VPN and encryption at the network layer, and Zero Trust principles applied to real infrastructure. Multi-vendor experience (for example, Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Nokia) is expected.
  • Working knowledge of applied cryptography as it appears in networks: TLS, IPsec, MACsec, PKI and certificate lifecycle, key management, and how algorithm and key material choices are made and changed in practice.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in front of customers at multiple levels — leading workshops, running architecture discussions with engineers, and holding a credible conversation with a CISO or SVP of Infrastructure about risk, cost, and sequencing.
  • A serious interest in where this is heading, and enough grounding to be credible on day one: post-quantum cryptography and crypto-agility, quantum key distribution, and the migration challenge facing existing networks. You do not need to have shipped a PQC migration — very few people have — but you should be able to reason about the problem rigorously and be visibly motivated to go deep.
  • Strong written communication. Architectures, migration plans, and design guidance are a large part of the output.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30%, primarily within the US, with incidental international travel.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with post-quantum cryptography migration: cryptographic discovery and inventory, crypto-agility architecture, hybrid key exchange, or PQC deployment in a network or PKI context.
  • Hands-on exposure to quantum key distribution or quantum networking — testbeds, carrier or research trials, key delivery interfaces to encryptors, or optical and transport-layer integration.
  • Experience at a network or security vendor, service provider, hyperscaler, or a large enterprise network or security team — with real accountability for architecture decisions at scale.
  • Familiarity with the security and compliance frameworks customers will map this work to: NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, FISMA, FedRAMP, or sector-specific regulation.
  • Public-sector, defense, financial services, or telecom experience, where high-assurance and long data-confidentiality horizons make this problem urgent today.
  • Contributions to standards or the technical community: IETF, ETSI, national PQC migration working groups, published writing, or conference talks.
  • Certifications that validate technical depth — CISSP, CCIE/JNCIE, CCNP Security, or equivalent.
  • Comfort with automation and tooling — Python, config-as-code, network telemetry — enough to build a credible demo or analysis yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About PraxentPraxent builds software for financial services companies — banks, credit unions, lenders, insurers, and wealth platforms.
jobs.description:
About Praxent

Praxent builds software for financial services companies — banks, credit unions, lenders, insurers, and wealth platforms. We have been doing it for over twenty years, from Austin, with a delivery team spread across the US and Latin America.

We are an Anthropic partner, and building agentic AI systems inside our clients' environments is now a core part of the work rather than an experiment on the side. This role exists because that work needs a different kind of engineer than a traditional project team supplies — someone who sits with the client, decides what should get built, and builds it.

This is the first Forward Deployed Engineer hire at Praxent. You would be defining the role, not inheriting it.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live in the following locations: Texas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Massachusetts, Maryland, Minnesota, North Carolina, Nebraska, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, South Carolina, Washington.

Applicants for this position must be currently and legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, J-1, F-1, CPT, OPT, etc.).

Praxent will not offer immigration sponsorship or assume sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.

International relocation or remote work arrangements outside of the U.S. will not be considered.

About the role

A Forward Deployed Engineer at Praxent embeds with a client, figures out what they actually need, and builds it. Not a spec handed down from a product manager — you are in the discovery conversation, you decide what gets built, and you ship it to production and stay until it works.

You will spend more than half your time in front of the people whose problem you are solving, and the rest of it writing the code that solves it. You are not shielded from the client. You are not handed a ticket queue. When a client asks for the wrong thing, talking them into the right thing is your job, not someone else's.

The shorthand we use internally is founder-level autonomy with staff-engineer-level rigor. You make the technical call in the room and defend it, rather than routing it back for sign-off. That is a real grant of authority, and it comes with real accountability for the outcome.

Financial services makes this harder and more interesting than it would be elsewhere. The systems are old, the data is regulated, the stakeholders are risk-averse for good reasons, and the gap between a working demo and something a bank will actually run in production is where most AI projects die. Closing that gap is the whole job.

What you'll do

  • Own technical delivery end to end on your accounts — discovery, architecture, build, production, and the messy weeks after launch.
  • Embed with client engineering and business teams. Translate a VP's business problem into an architecture, and that architecture back into language the VP can defend to their board.
  • Build production applications and agentic systems inside client environments: LLM-backed workflows, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and integrations against core banking, lending, policy administration, and financial data systems.
  • Design the integration surface. Most of this work is API design and systems integration against platforms that were not built to be integrated with.
  • Harden prototypes into systems a regulated institution will actually run — security review, audit trail, PII handling, performance under real load. The distance between a working demo and a production deployment at a bank is most of the job.
  • Scope down. Identify when a client is asking for the wrong thing and talk them into the right thing. This is the part of the job we care most about.
  • Guide the client's own engineers. Part of leaving well is that their team can extend what you built without calling us.
  • Own the hardest production problems on your accounts — the ones that surface at 4pm on a Friday in someone else's infrastructure.
  • Own the implementation plan and direct the work. You decide the sequence, and as an engagement scales you delegate to the engineers around you — including the internal AI engineers who will work for you. This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management one.
  • Make the case for growth by building things worth expanding. You carry no revenue target and you do not run the commercial conversation — our Client Partners do that. Your argument is the solution itself.
  • Flag risk before it becomes a problem.
  • Leave behind documented, runnable, maintainable software that still works after you rotate off.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years shipping production software, full-stack. Python is what most of this work is written in; .NET or Node are fine substitutes. React or Next.js on the front end.
  • Experience leading the technical side of a delivery. You have owned an implementation plan, sequenced the work, and directed other engineers without being their manager.
  • API design and systems integration. You have integrated against something old, poorly documented, and load-bearing, and made it hold.
  • Real client-facing delivery experience. You have run a discovery session, handled a difficult stakeholder, and delivered an account without someone above you managing the relationship.
  • Production experience with LLMs and agents. Prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, deployment at scale. Application engineering, not ML research.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You deliver value before all the requirements are defined, because they never are.
  • Range in the room. You are precise with engineers and clear with executives, and you can switch between those two rooms inside an hour.
  • A story about scoping down. A time you told a client not to build something, and why you were right.
  • Willingness to travel to client sites 20–30% of the time.

What You’ll Love About Us:

  • Stability. We've been in business for over 25 years.
  • Work stays at work. We promote a healthy work/life balance to help ensure you have the time that you need. We encourage no more than a 40 hour work week.
  • Great company culture. We’ve been recognized by Texas Monthly, Clutch, Comparably, and more for the quality of our workplace. Feel free to check out our rating on Glassdoor.
  • We’re here to empower you. It’s your work and your career. Our management team is here to help you become who you want to be. Not to micromanage you.
  • Stay healthy. We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as wellness days. We also provide disability insurance and we even have a wellness program.
  • Plan for the future. We don’t want you to work here forever. Save for retirement with an IRA and we’ll match up to 3% every year.
  • We value your ideas. At Praxent, our doors are always open. Need help? Come on in. Have a vision for the future of the company? We’d love to hear it.
  • Rest and relaxation. Employees enjoy 15 days of PTO, 9 US holidays, 5 sick days, and a closed office the last week of the year. Employees earn more PTO each year.
  • You’re more than an employee, you’re a person. Every co-worker you’ll meet is committed to treating you with respect and kindness. You won’t hear stuff like, “It’s just business.”
  • Family values. Praxent provides paid parental leave.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $205,000 - $250,000 + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Senior Manager, Obesity Coverage and Value Strategy

What you will do


The Senior Manager Obesity and Related Conditions (OaR) Coverage and Value Strategy owns the U.S. payer coverage and value-marketing agenda for OaR. The role turns clinical, economic, patient and market evidence into segment and account-level access strategy, compelling payer communication and practical field pull-through that improves appropriate coverage and reduces access friction. The role owns prior-authorization and utilization-management analysis and supplies approved coverage assumptions to the Pricing Lead.


Core responsibilities:


  • Lead the integrated U.S. coverage strategy across commercial, Medicare and Medicaid segments, including payer segmentation, access objectives, account priorities and plans to establish, improve and protect coverage.
  • Define the desired coverage and utilization-management position, including formulary tier, prior authorization, step therapy, reauthorization, quantity limits and clinical criteria; assess patient-journey and business implications.
  • Own prior-authorization and utilization-management analysis, including criteria benchmarking, documentation burden, patient-flow implications, approval and denial patterns, renewal requirements, administrative friction and alternative policy scenarios.
  • Provide clear, approved coverage, prior authorization criteria , step and reauthorization assumptions to the Pricing Lead for gross to net (GTN) and contract modeling; explain changes and uncertainty without transferring ownership of the access analysis.
  • Partner with Pricing, Contracting, Insights and field access teams to translate payer realities into coverage strategies, contracting objectives, pull-through plans and escalation priorities.
  • Lead the U.S. payer value story and customer-specific value communication, connecting MariTide clinical profile, burden of obesity and related conditions, health-economic evidence, patient experience and affordability to payer decision needs.
  • Develop, refresh and govern payer-facing materials and field tools, including value dossiers, payer presentations, objection handlers, coverage resources, FAQs, training content and account-planning aids through the appropriate review process.
  • Lead payer, employer and market research to test coverage barriers, evidence needs, benefit-management expectations, value messages and evolving obesity policies; convert findings into prioritized actions.
  • Collaborate with Health Economics Outcomes Research and Real World Evidence, Medical and Global Value and Access on evidence priorities, payer objections and evidence dissemination; identify evidence gaps that could improve coverage or reduce utilization burden.
  • Track coverage performance and access Key Performance Indicators by segment and customer; diagnose barriers using formulary, claims, field and customer insight; mobilize accountable partners to close priority gaps.
  • Shape value evidence and coverage implications for employer and consumer pathways when requested, while the Consumer Director and Employer Lead Director retain ownership of their strategies and relationships.
  • Partner with Brand, Patient Access & Reimbursement on affordability and access education, consumer and Health Care Professional experience, and the clinical-operational handoffs required for patients to start and persist appropriately.
  • Present concise coverage, evidence and value recommendations to the Director and appropriate launch or governance forums; make dependencies, uncertainties and decisions explicit.

What we expect of you


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is someone with these qualifications.


Basic qualifications:


  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of market access, value marketing, HEOR, payer strategy, reimbursement, pricing, contracting, finance, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • Master’s degree and 4 years of market access, value marketing, HEOR, payer strategy, reimbursement, pricing, contracting, finance, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of market access, value marketing, HEOR, payer strategy, reimbursement, pricing, contracting, finance, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • Associate’s degree and 10 years of market access, value marketing, HEOR, payer strategy, reimbursement, pricing, contracting, finance, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • High school diploma or GED and 12 years of market access, value marketing, HEOR, payer strategy, reimbursement, pricing, contracting, finance, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience in payer marketing, coverage strategy, managed markets, HEOR or value communication, patient access, or a payer, PBM or employer setting; launch experience in chronic, primary-care or cardiometabolic markets preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. pharmacy and medical benefits, formulary decision-making, prior authorization, step therapy, reauthorization, benefit design and access operations.
  • Ability to interpret clinical trials, real-world evidence and health-economic analyses and translate them accurately for payer coverage and utilization-management decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing compliant payer or access materials and enabling customer-facing teams through training and pull-through tools.
  • Strong strategic thinking, synthesis, facilitation, writing and presentation skills; able to independently lead a defined strategic workstream and influence in a matrixed launch environment.

What you can expect of us


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Aqui, quem chama pra si o problema sem dono e entrega algo acima do esperado cresce rápido. Quem prefere o caminho óbvio, não.

  • mais de 7 bilhões de documentos jurídicos de interesse público
  • mais de 80% dos advogados brasileiros cadastrados
  • 670 pessoas jusbrasileiras, quase metade em tecnologia e produto
  • presença em mais de 125 cidades no Brasil e fora
  • modelo remoto: liberdade de escolher onde viver, sem perder a vaga certa

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Staff Product Manager para transitar entre um produto já estabilizado e produtos ainda em construção, com maturidade para se adaptar ao momento de cada frente.

Esperamos profundidade para entender o problema real do usuário antes de propor qualquer solução. Mais do que liderar entregas, esperamos alguém capaz de operar em ambiente de alta ambiguidade — onde muitas das melhores práticas para construir produtos de IA ainda estão sendo definidas — e de estabelecer padrões, processos e direcionamentos que sustentem o crescimento da área no longo prazo.

Você vai trabalhar de perto com Engenharia e Design dentro dos squads de produto, e vai interagir continuamente com Growth e Marketing para conectar a estratégia de produto à aquisição de usuários.

Responsabilidades

  • Contribuir com uma visão de longo prazo para o portfólio de produtos voltados à população geral, equilibrando ganhos de curto prazo com sustentabilidade da estratégia.
  • Estruturar o diagnóstico e a estratégia de produto para acelerar a aquisição de usuários que estão fora do nicho jurídico, alcançando a população em geral.
  • Ser uma liderança técnica dos produtos de massa do Jusbrasil, com flexibilidade para atuar onde o negócio precisar no curto prazo.
  • Conduzir discovery e ciclos de experimentação completos — hipótese, execução, resultado medido — em produtos que vão de estágio inicial a produtos já maduros.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares como Growth, Marketing, Product Design e Engenharia para que as apostas de produto sustentem os movimentos de aquisição em massa (TV, mídias sociais, influenciadores, parcerias estratégicas, etc.), garantindo que entregamos valor e que sejam sustentáveis no longo prazo.
  • Atuar como referência estratégica em produto de IA aplicado ao jurídico, influenciando decisões sobre arquitetura, padrões de construção e direcionamentos para novas frentes.
  • Definir métricas de sucesso por habilidade e mecanismos de aprendizado contínuo, equilibrando experimentação, qualidade e impacto no uso real do produto.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Habilidade em traduzir hipóteses em experiências simples, úteis e confiáveis para os usuários.
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e construção fundacional, estabelecendo padrões onde ainda não existem.
  • Experiência sólida em Produto, com histórico tanto em construção de produtos do zero (0→1) quanto em otimização de produtos já maduros.
  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade de construir uma narrativa sólida a partir de dados incompletos ou ambíguos.

  • Gerenciamento de múltiplos stakeholders como Engenharia, Design, Growth e Marketing.

Diferenciais

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to .

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Vice President of Consulting to lead and scale a high-impact consulting organization responsible for delivering data-driven marketing strategy, measurement, and activation across our client portfolio. This leader will oversee multiple consulting disciplines while remaining hands-on in shaping client strategy, solving complex business problems, and driving measurable outcomes.

This role requires a unique blend of executive leadership, deep marketing and data expertise, and practitioner-level execution. The ideal candidate brings a strong point of view on identity-driven, omnichannel marketing—understanding how data, targeting, and measurement intersect to drive performance across the full customer lifecycle.

You will serve as both an organizational leader and senior strategic advisor, accountable for team performance, client impact, and revenue growth tied to consulting engagements.

This role requires expertise in leveraging 1st & 3rd party data to deliver strategies that improve customer experience and drive engagement and revenue throughout the entire customer funnel within both paid and owned marketing channels.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for interpreting complex datasets, designing measurable experiments, and translating insights into actionable roadmaps. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to refine marketing efforts through holistic planning, personalization, channel orchestration, and innovative measurement techniques.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership, Team Development & Scalability

  • Develop, mentor, and train a high-performing team of Consultants on best practices for diagnosing, structuring, and solving complex client business challenges using strategic, data-driven, and methodical consulting approaches.
  • Establish repeatable frameworks, problem-solving methodologies, and consultative processes that drive consistency, scalability, and measurable client outcomes across engagements.
  • Identify and mentor rising talent within the team (or region) to build a bench of future consultants and support succession planning.
  • Foster a collaborative and innovative culture, promoting professional growth and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Partner across Data Cloud, Product, and Engineering teams to provide feedback on evolving client needs, shape roadmap priorities, and identify scalable consulting solutions or automation opportunities.

Data Interpretation, Tactical Roadmaps & Standardization

  • Design comprehensive data strategies based on client goals, identifying both first-party (1P) and third-party (3P) data use cases that will optimize performance in paid or owned channels.
  • Translate client business goals into actionable, insight-driven media and CRM plans, and develop strategic recommendations that maximize marketing ROI.
  • Translate complex data visualizations and dashboards into clear tactical roadmaps. Collaborate internally on a step-by-step plan for activation by channel.
  • Operationalize use of generative AI and predictive analytics tools to streamline consulting workflows, proposal generation, and client storytelling. Train team members and evangelize AI-first thinking across consulting and client teams.
  • Identify gaps in current data visualizations and dashboards that will result in added revenue opportunities for a broad range of clients.

Omnichannel Activation & Measurement

  • Drive the development and implementation of innovative marketing measurement frameworks, clearly measuring the impact of omnichannel strategies on both brand and performance goals.
  • Advise clients on optimizing customer journeys through marketing funnel diagnostics and optimization.
  • Identify and evaluate new data sets that would create a differentiator for Zeta by delivering a deeper understanding of campaign performance and the impact on customer value compared to competitors.

Consultation & Thought Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives and senior leaders, identifying data-driven quick wins that produce incremental revenue for their business. Guide the strategy for QBRs and Key Stakeholder meetings.
  • Standardize the development of proformas for prospects and existing clients, projecting the quarterly revenue impact from activating data-driven audience & campaign recommendations.
  • Support Sales SVPs in pitching incremental campaign strategies and expanded channel recommendations that result in added revenue based on our data intelligence or measurement capabilities.
  • Build data intelligence workshops and playbooks for top tier accounts that outline a crawl/walk/run vision for data intelligence that aligns to their individual goals and objectives.
  • Develop new data-driven storytelling capabilities that answer for a client what will drive engagement and why, building a framework that can be automated for future use cases.
  • Collaborate with Account Teams and Sales to identify expansion opportunities and track contribution. Report out to upper management team impact weekly.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 12+ Years of experience in data-driven marketing strategy, campaign measurement, and client engagement/growth roles -- with hands-on experience leading strategic planning, brand, and performance marketing programs.
  • Experience with advanced data segmentation strategies, statistical testing methods, and multi-touch attribution models.
  • Excellent ability to synthesize data into insights and develop actionable recommendations and roadmaps.
  • Exceptional communication skills to effectively collaborate and present to C-Level Executives, as well as distill visions down to a practical application for cross-functional & internal teams.
  • A proven track record in developing audience strategies, campaign measurement frameworks, and leveraging addressable/people-based marketing to solve for real business outcomes.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this role is $180,000 - $200,000, depending on location and experience.

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for coordinating the successful delivery of customer projects and service engagements by aligning resource capacity with customer demand, driving project execution, and ensuring delivery commitments are met. This role serves as the operational hub between customers, delivery teams, project resources, and leadership to ensure projects are properly staffed, risks are proactively managed, and customer expectations are consistently achieved.

The Service Delivery Manager oversees project governance, resource planning, meeting facilitation, action item management, and escalation resolution while maintaining visibility into project health, resource utilization, timelines, budgets, and overall customer satisfaction.

You will lead end-to-end delivery of Palantir-based programs, ensuring alignment between stakeholders, timelines, and technical teams.

Role Description

Resource Management & Capacity Planning

  • Maintain visibility into all available service delivery resources and project assignments.

  • Align inbound project demand with available resource capacity and skill sets.

  • Coordinate resource assignments across multiple customer engagements and projects.

  • Monitor resource utilization and recommend adjustments to optimize delivery performance.

  • Identify resource constraints and skill gaps and develop mitigation plans.

  • Partner with delivery leaders and functional managers on staffing priorities and future resource needs.

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Track all incoming projects and service engagements from initiation through completion.

  • Ensure projects are appropriately staffed and aligned to customer requirements.

  • Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, and deliverables.

  • Facilitate project status meetings, delivery reviews, and customer update meetings.

  • Ensure projects remain on track and proactively address obstacles impacting delivery.

  • Support project teams in developing and executing recovery plans when necessary.

Governance & Accountability

  • Facilitate recurring project and operational review meetings.

  • Document meeting outcomes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.

  • Distribute meeting notes within established timelines.

  • Track action items through completion and hold stakeholders accountable for commitments.

  • Maintain project dashboards, status reports, risk logs, and delivery metrics.

  • Ensure consistent adherence to delivery processes and governance standards.

Risk & Escalation Management

  • Identify and manage project risks related to scope, budget, timeline, resources, and technical dependencies.

  • Maintain risk and issue logs for active projects.

  • Work with project teams to develop mitigation plans and corrective actions.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for project delivery and resource-related issues.

  • Drive issue resolution while maintaining alignment among stakeholders.

  • Escalate significant risks and concerns to leadership when appropriate.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and internal teams.

  • Provide clear communication regarding project status, risks, resource challenges, and delivery commitments.

  • Facilitate discussions to resolve competing priorities and delivery challenges.

  • Support customer satisfaction through proactive communication and successful execution.

  • Ensure customer expectations are aligned with project objectives and delivery capabilities.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Teamwork: Can work effectively in a team, contributing ideas and effort, and respecting the contributions of others.

  • Customer Service: Can identify customer needs, propose suitable solutions, and handle more complex customer interactions.

  • Organization: Can prioritize daily tasks, manage personal workflow, and utilize basic tools to keep track of responsibilities.

  • Time Management: Can generally use time effectively but may occasionally struggle with prioritizing tasks, meeting deadlines, or maintaining work-life balance.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can apply critical thinking to analyze data, identify patterns, and make basic inferences.

  • Problem-Solving: Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action to resolve them without explicit instructions.

  • Detail-Oriented: Can identify errors or inconsistencies in work and make necessary corrections.

  • Presenting: Can prepare and deliver presentations, addressing key points and responding to questions with clarity.

  • Self-Motivation: Can identify personal or professional growth opportunities, propose self-improvement strategies, and take action without explicit instructions.

  • Negotiation: Can identify opportunities for compromise, propose solutions, and take action to influence outcomes without explicit instructions.

  • Initiative: Can identify opportunities for improvement, propose solutions, and take action without explicit instructions.

  • Consultative Sales: Can identify customer needs, propose suitable products or services, and take action to close sales without explicit instructions.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.

  • Experience with resource planning and capacity management.

  • Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, and stakeholder communications.

  • Experience supporting customer-facing delivery organizations.

  • Resource Management and Workforce Planning

  • Project and Program Management

  • Meeting Facilitation

  • Risk and Issue Management

  • Executive Communication

  • Customer Relationship Management

  • Escalation Management

  • Conflict Resolution

  • Organizational and Planning Skills

Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience required

  • 5+ years of project management, service delivery, or operations management experience.

Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data. Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100.

As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed.

Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.

Job Description:

Drive high-impact deployments at the intersection of data intelligence, AI, and governance. As a Staff Deployment Strategist, you act as a hands-on builder and trusted technical advisor, partnering with customer stakeholders to design, build, and embed agentic solutions using Alation's configuration-first platform. You lead complex deployments end-to-end — from discovery through value realization — translating ambiguous requirements into enterprise-grade outcomes.

You are not just an advisor; you are a builder. You work closely with senior customer stakeholders — typically Directors and Sr. Directors, with executive exposure common but usually partnered with account leadership — to shape a deployment's direction, then roll up your sleeves to prototype and configure the AI agents, analytical workflows, and governance patterns that bring it to life. You raise delivery standards and reduce risk through anticipation, not heroics.

What You’ll Do

Solution Design & Discovery

  • Diagnose & Design: Lead discovery sessions with customer stakeholders to surface business challenges, data and governance gaps, and high-value opportunities for AI automation.

  • Rapid Prototyping: Rapidly prototype and validate AI agent solutions using Alation's platform — build functional low/no-code prototypes and proof-of-concept agents to validate hypotheses and demonstrate value.

  • Value Framing: Define KPIs and value measures for the engagement; build a defensible, data-backed value story that links technical work to customer outcomes.

  • Solution Architecture: Architect scalable, maintainable configuration-first solutions across a customer's ecosystem, balancing quick wins with long-term maintainability; make sound configuration-vs-customization tradeoffs.

Delivery Ownership & Client Integration

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own complex deployment delivery across multiple workstreams, stakeholder groups, and system integrations — from discovery through design, build, and consumption.

  • Operational Integration: Drive consumption and change plans so solutions are embedded, not just installed — including enablement, workflow integration, and governance reinforcement.

  • Stakeholder Facilitation: Run high-impact workshops and facilitate decisions across conflicting stakeholder goals; regularly engage Directors/Sr. Directors, with exec engagement common but typically partnered with account leadership.

  • Scope & Risk Management: Proactively manage scope, risk, and interdependencies across workstreams; course-correct early rather than relying on heroics.

  • Feedback Loop: Provide structured product feedback — patterns, gaps, recurring friction — to improve the platform and delivery playbooks.

Value Realization & Growth

  • Value Realization: Contribute to and help deliver Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), presenting outcomes and impact with supporting data.

  • Expansion Support: Identify expansion opportunities that surface from delivered outcomes and partner with the account team to pursue them.

  • Reusable Patterns: Create reusable patterns, accelerators, and playbooks that other Deployment Strategists adopt — not just strong individual delivery.

What You Bring

  • Experience:6 years in management consulting (strategy, operations, tech) or forward-deployed solution roles at data platform companies.

  • Technical Fluency:Hands-on with data (SQL essential); familiar with Python, APIs, and modern data architectures. You can read code, work in SQL, and build in low/no-code platforms, and hold your own with a technical team — but you're not writing production software.

  • Stakeholder Presence:Strong communication skills and presence with Director/Sr. Director-level stakeholders; comfortable in exec-facing moments, typically alongside account leadership.

  • Builder Portfolio:Demonstrated track record of building and deploying low/no-code solutions, and moving them from prototype to production.

  • Problem Solving: Strong problem solver who synthesizes ambiguity — across workstreams, systems, and stakeholders — into clear, actionable plans.

  • AI & Data Governance: Working understanding of AI agent patterns, LLMs, data governance, and metadata management (preferred).

  • Education: Technical undergraduate or graduate program preferred. An advanced degree (MBA, technical Master's) is a plus, but demonstrated impact and leadership matter most.

  • Travel: Ability to travel for customer and prospect onsite visits (approx. 15–30%).

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

‎

The Director, Risk Adjustment Product & Technology will lead the product roadmap, and technology capabilities that enable Mosaic Health to identify, prioritize, orchestrate, and capture burden-of-illness opportunities across its patient populations.

This role will own the evolution of Mosaic’s enterprise Burden of Illness (BOI) Hub—the centralized intelligence and orchestration layer that brings together clinical, claims, payer, attribution, and supplemental data to determine which patients and clinical opportunities should be acted upon, through which intervention, and at what point in the workflow.

The Director will move the organization from fragmented, vendor-specific, and manually driven prioritization toward an enterprise-owned approach to risk adjustment decisioning and orchestration. The role will oversee how opportunities are identified, deduplicated, economically prioritized, routed to the appropriate execution engine, and measured through completion.

Sitting within Clinical Technology, this leader will partner closely with Risk Adjustment, Clinical, Coding, Operations, Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, Finance, and market leadership.

The Director will also serve as a senior product and technology partner to external vendors, ensuring that platforms such as Navina operate as execution engines within Mosaic’s broader enterprise strategy rather than independently defining prioritization and workflow

The successful candidate will combine expertise in risk adjustment, healthcare product management, clinical technology, data, workflow design, and value-based care economics.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Strategic Leadership

  • Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Mosaic’s enterprise risk adjustment technology capabilities.
  • Lead development and maturation of the Burden of Illness Hub as the central orchestration capability for risk adjustment and related clinical opportunities.
  • Translate Risk Adjustment, Clinical, Operations, market, payer, and financial requirements into scalable product and technology capabilities.
  • Establish a clear distinction between:
    • enterprise-owned decisioning and prioritization,
    • foundational data capabilities,
    • execution engines,
    • vendor functionality, and
    • provider, coder, and operational workflows.
  • Define the target-state architecture and multi-year roadmap for moving from fragmented tools and processes to a standardized enterprise platform.

Burden of Illness Hub

  • Build the Hub as the enterprise system for:

- patient eligibility and prioritization,

- attributed and high-probability unattributed population identification,

- suspect and opportunity aggregation,

- opportunity deduplication,

- clinical and economic prioritization,

- work queue generation,

- intervention routing,

- opportunity status and disposition,

- attribution and retention interventions, and

- enterprise performance analytics.


  • Establish common rules and governance for determining when an opportunity should be surfaced, suppressed, combined, escalated, or routed to an alternative intervention.
  • Ensure prioritization logic is transparent, measurable, and configurable by population, payer, market, and intervention type.
  • Create feedback loops in which outcomes from providers, coders, AI, and other interventions continuously improve future prioritization.

Strategic Leadership

  • Own product requirements and prioritization for risk adjustment technology capabilities across the enterprise.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture, and Clinical Informatics to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define product requirements, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, and outcome measures for major capabilities.
  • Maintain a prioritized product backlog and roadmap aligned to enterprise objectives.
  • Establish appropriate product governance, release planning, testing, adoption, and change-management processes.
  • Ensure risk adjustment technology integrates effectively with EHRs, clinical applications, analytics platforms, data infrastructure, and operational systems.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies—including AI, NLP, clinical inference, and automation—for their ability to improve identification, prioritization, and capture of clinically appropriate opportunities.

Change Management & Adoption

The Director will ensure that multiple execution channels operate against a common enterprise prioritization strategy, including:

  • Point-of-care clinical technology and provider workflows
  • Platforms such as Navina
  • Coding and chart review teams
  • Incremental AI and clinical rules
  • Prospective and retrospective interventions
  • Provider and coder workflows
  • Attribution and patient retention interventions
  • Operational outreach and work queues

The Director will define when and how opportunities move between these execution channels and establish clear ownership, handoffs, and disposition logic.

The goal is not simply to generate more suspecting opportunities, but to ensure that the highest-value, clinically appropriate opportunity reaches the most effective intervention at the right time.

Vendor Strategy and Management

  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, analytics, finance, compliance, and technology teams to align priorities and execution.
  • Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams including workflow analysts, clinical informatics resources, optimization specialists, and program managers.
  • Manage vendor relationships and participate in technology selection and evaluation processes.
  • Support enterprise scaling efforts, acquisitions, integrations, and operational transformation initiatives.

Performance & Analytics

  • Define and monitor operational and clinical metrics tied to workflow optimization initiatives.
  • Use data and analytics to identify inefficiencies, quantify impact, and guide prioritization decisions.
  • Develop executive-level reporting demonstrating ROI, adoption, productivity, and quality outcomes.
  • Drive continuous improvement methodologies across workflow and technology initiatives.

Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, nursing, informatics, business, information systems, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, clinical informatics, healthcare technology, or workflow optimization, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise clinical transformation or EHR optimization initiatives at scale.
  • Proven success driving cross-functional operational and technology initiatives in complex healthcare environments.
  • Strong understanding of ambulatory and/or population health clinical workflows.
  • Experience with change management, clinician stakeholder engagement, and adoption strategies.
  • Track record of translating technology capabilities into measurable clinical and operational outcomes.

Preferred Experience


  • Advanced degree (MHA, MBA, MS in Informatics, or equivalent).
  • Certification or demonstrated proficiency in EHR workflow optimization.
  • Experience implementing ambient AI documentation tools or AI-enabled clinical decision support.
  • Background in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).
  • Experience in a multi-entity or integrated healthcare delivery system spanning primary care, specialty, and value-based care models.

Technical Fluency


  • Working knowledge of EHR platforms and clinical workflow configuration, particularly Athena.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled clinical tools, telehealth platforms, and digital health technologies and their integration into clinical workflows.
  • Understanding of population health platforms and care management tools.
  • Ability to translate workflow and technology concepts clearly across clinical, operational, and technical audiences.

Skills & Competencies


  • Executive presence with the ability to communicate clinical technology strategy to senior clinical, operational, and business audiences.
  • Strong instincts for driving adoption and behavior change across large, distributed clinical populations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management — this leader earns credibility by delivering change that clinicians experience as meaningful improvement.
  • Commitment to measurable outcomes, continuous improvement, and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Ability to lead through managers and analysts, setting direction and holding teams accountable to a high standard.
