  • Monitor emerging accounting guidance issued by the FASB, SEC, and PCAOB; assess impact on the company; and lead implementation of new standards, including drafting accounting policies and coordinating cross-functional rollout.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors on technical accounting matters, leading discussions and resolving complex issues efficiently.
  • Partner with Legal, Treasury, Revenue, FP&A, and business unit leaders to evaluate the accounting implications of new contracts, deal structures, and strategic initiatives before they close.
  • Support M&A activity, including purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-acquisition integration from a technical accounting perspective.
  • Develop, maintain, and update the company's accounting policy manual, ensuring policies remain current and are consistently applied across the organization.
  • Assess internal controls related to complex accounting areas and partner with Internal Controls/SOX teams to ensure adequate control design and operation.
  • Present technical accounting matters to senior leadership and, as needed, the Audit Committee.
  • Partner directly with the Chief Accounting Officer and engage with industry working groups, standard-setters, and peer companies to help shape emerging positions on cutting-edge accounting standards affecting digital assets and the broader industry.
  • Mentor and develop accounting staff, building technical accounting capability across the broader finance organization.
  • Assist with SEC reporting (10-K/10-Q) disclosures related to technical accounting areas, as applicable.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • CPA license (active and in good standing).
  • 12+ years of progressive accounting experience, including significant experience in public accounting (Big 4 or national firm) and/or a technical accounting role in industry.
  • Deep, current knowledge of U.S. GAAP with demonstrated experience researching and documenting complex technical accounting positions.
  • Strong understanding of SEC reporting requirements (for public companies) or equivalent stakeholder reporting needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex accounting concepts for non-accounting audiences.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience with digital assets/cryptocurrency accounting, including familiarity with ASC 350-60, token economics, DeFi, staking, and other blockchain-native transaction structures.
  • Public company experience, including direct interaction with external auditors.
  • Experience with M&A transaction accounting and purchase accounting.
  • Experience with system implementations affecting accounting processes (e.g., ERP, revenue systems).
  • Prior people-management or mentorship experience.
  • Experience in the blockchain, Web3, or fintech industry a plus.

jobs.description:
Discom is the global market and technology leader in acoustic quality analysis and end-of-line (EoL) production testing for the automotive industry. As an innovation driver within Hottinger Brüel & Kjær (HBK), we solve noise and vibration problems for assembly units worldwide ranging from classic transmissions and combustion engines to advanced powertrain technologies and emerging applications such as actuator systems.

Our high-precision measurement systems (comprising state-of-the-art sensors, frontend hardware, and advanced analysis software) are integrated into production test benches globally to detect assembly faults and ensure the highest acoustic quality. What differentiates us is the unique combination of high-precision measurement technology and deep application know-how, enabling our customers to solve complex NVH challenges directly in their production processes.

To accelerate our growth and strengthen our presence in the North American market, we are seeking a highly motivated, technically minded Business Development Manager (USA).

Role Purpose

This role is dedicated to expanding Discom’s footprint in the US automotive and industrial testing markets. You will drive growth by identifying new business opportunities, acquiring new strategic customers (OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and test bench manufacturers), and establishing Discom as the go-to partner for NVH and acoustic testing solutions in the USA. In this role, you will also act as a key bridge between US customers and our engineering teams in Germany, with direct influence on product development and market positioning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, target, and acquire new customers and applications within the US automotive market, with a strong focus on eDrive, transmission, drivetrain and emerging actuator and new applications e.g. humanoids.
  • Act as the technical and commercial expert for Discom’s NVH EoL testing systems, explaining complex acoustic and vibration measurement concepts to engineering and quality assurance teams.
  • Proactively generate and nurture high-quality sales leads, managing the full sales cycle from initial contact to closing.
  • Understand customer-specific test bench requirements and collaborate on tailoring Discom’s hardware and software solutions to their production lines.
  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear value propositions for the customer, such as improved quality assurance, reduced production risks, and more efficient data-driven decision-making.
  • Gather deep market insights and act as the “voice of the customer” to provide feedback to our German R&D and Engineering teams, supporting market-driven product development.
  • Manage and track your sales pipeline and local order intake, providing transparent reporting and accurate forecasting.
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with key accounts, supporting them through test installations and evaluations.
  • Participate in industry trade shows, conferences, and customer workshops to build brand awareness for Discom in North America.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Acoustics, or a comparable technical discipline.
  • Proven track record in technical sales, application engineering, or business development, preferably within the automotive, test automation, or measurement technology sectors.
  • Solid technical understanding of acoustics, vibration analysis, or NVH (Noise, Vibration, Harshness). Prior experience with rotating machinery, drivetrains, or EoL testing is highly beneficial.
  • Highly motivated self-starter with a strong ownership mindset and entrepreneurial drive, able to work independently in a remote set-up.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams (especially with HQ in Germany).
  • Willingness to travel extensively within the USA (approx. 50%) to visit customers, test benches, and partners, with occasional trips to the HQ in Germany and our partners in China.

What We Offer

  • Pivotal, high-impact role with high autonomy to play a lead part in expanding a global technology leader's presence in a key strategic market, actively shaping and developing your market.
  • Attractive compensation package, including performance-based incentives and comprehensive benefits.
  • An entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making paths, backed by the global strength of Hottinger Brüel & Kjær (HBK).
  • Cutting-edge technology in high-growth segments like advanced powertrain technologies and sensor applications.
  • Collaborating with a highly skilled and supportive U.S. team of application engineers and inside sales, with strong backing from global experts and engineering teams in Germany and China.
  • Close interaction with product development teams, giving you the opportunity to directly influence future solutions and market direction based on customer insights.
  • A growing US organization, closely connected to our global teams and supported by a strong technical backbone in Germany.

Compensation

The pay range for this position is $105,000 to $115,000 annually plus 25% bonus. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on factors, including but not limited to the individual's qualifications, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as physical work location within the state.

News Editor, Newsweek.com

Location: United States (Remote or Hybrid in NYC)

Position Overview:
The Senior Editor is a senior operational authority in Newsweek’s U.S. newsroom, responsible for setting the editorial bar and enforcing it relentlessly. This role demands editors who can run a national news desk at full throttle—making high-stakes editorial decisions in real time, rewriting aggressively, and delivering journalism that competes head-to-head with the strongest U.S. newsrooms. Reporting to the US News Director, the Senior Editor owns daily execution of the U.S. news report, turning strategy into journalism that is fast, authoritative, analytically sharp, and unmistakably worth a reader’s time. This is a role for editors who expect to touch the most important stories themselves, not manage them from a distance.

This is a full-time position working 10:00am-7:00pm ET five days a week with a rotating weekend shift. This position may be worked remotely anywhere in the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

Desk Command & Editorial Judgment

  • Run the U.S. news desk during peak coverage hours, making final calls on framing, prioritization, and play.
  • Distinguish decisively between stories that advance public understanding and those that merely follow the pack.
  • Kill weak or redundant stories quickly—and demand better replacements.

Elite Editing & Rewrite Authority

  • Deliver first-class framing on the most competitive national stories, identifying where Newsweek can add clarity, originality, or analytical value.
  • Rewrite without hesitation: leads, nut grafs, headlines, structure, sourcing, and tone.
  • Take raw field notes, transcripts, interviews, and exclusives and turn them into clean, analytical, tightly argued journalism.
  • Perform rapid second-day and rolling rewrites that materially improve stories as facts evolve.

Breaking News & Hands-On Reporting

  • Operate as a desk reporter when the moment demands it—making calls, confirming facts, chasing documents, and closing gaps.
  • Personally intervene on high-stakes or sensitive stories where precision and judgment are critical.

Standards, Culture & Accountability

  • Hold yourself and your team to elite newsroom standards.
  • Provide blunt, constructive feedback and demand improvement.
  • Mentor reporters and junior editors into sharper thinkers and stronger journalists.
  • Take ownership when coverage underperforms.

Audience & Competitive Awareness

  • Maintain a sophisticated understanding of how serious readers engage with news.
  • Work with audience teams to ensure performance goals support editorial ambition.
  • Monitor competitive coverage and push Newsweek to outperform, not echo.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • 7–10+ years of experience at a high-level U.S. digital newsroom.
  • Demonstrated record editing breaking news, exclusives, and enterprise reporting at speed.
  • Exceptional news judgment.
  • First-rate rewriting skills.
  • Comfortable making consequential editorial decisions independently.
  • Proven ability to handle sensitive and legally complex stories.
  • Deep understanding of U.S. political, legal, and cultural dynamics.
  • Calm, decisive leadership style under pressure.

Chiesi Global Rare Diseases

Chiesi Global Rare Diseases is a Chiesi Group’s business unit established in February 2020 and focused on research, development and commercialization of treatments and patient support services for rare and ultra-rare disorders, many of whom have limited or no treatments available.

This unit is based in Boston, Massachusetts, with a strong synergy with the headquarters in Parma.

Rare unit has a focus on research and product development for lysosomal storage diseases, rare hematology, ophthalmology disorders and rare immunodeficiencies. The unit is also a dedicated partner with global leaders in scientific research, patient advocacy and care. Discover more here.

What we are looking for

This is what you will do

Chiesi Global Rare disease is recruiting for a Senior Analytical Scientist with deep expertise in development of complex analytical methods including bioassays and cell-based potency assays for the characterization of ATMP including oligonucleotides, lipid nanoparticle (LNP) based products and other modalities.

In this role, you will be a key member of the CMC Extended Technical Team (ETT) , operating in a matrix organisation and responsible for driving analytical development and control strategy for gene editing products within the GRD function from candidate selection though clinical development and toward commercial launch, while also supporting lifecycle management activities.

You will be responsible for

  • Define and lead the development plan for bioanalytical and potency assay strategies for gene editing and nucleic acid-based therapeutics, acting as a subject matter expert (SME) in method development, validations and control strategies for the assigned projects
  • Drive fit-for-purpose assay development, evolving from early development to late-stage/GMP
  • Design and oversee the development of cell-based potency assays (primary cells, immortalized lines, reporter systems), functional assays for gene editing efficiency (e.g., knockout/knock-in models), mechanism-based assays reflecting biological activity (e.g., transfection, expression, editing efficiency)
  • Implement and oversee assay qualification/validation (accuracy, precision, specificity, linearity, robustness), stability-indicating and comparability assays,
  • Contribute to analytical characterization packages, linking potency to CQAs
  • Act as primary analytical lead for outsourced activities, including:
    • Selection and onboarding of CROs/CDMOs, including support in auditing and qualification
    • Technical oversight and governance of external partners ensuring robust and scientifically sound follow-up of external activities, driving accountability and continuous improvement.
    • Proactive troubleshooting and risk management
    • Review of critical protocol, methods and data generated at the CDMO
    • Manage analytical project budgets (CROs, CDMOs, consultants).
  • Actively contributing to the advancement of the project being a key player within the CMC team and ensuring compliance with overall program, budget and regulatory strategy
  • Write, review, and approve technical documentation within the area of responsibility, including development protocols and reports, stability studies, deviation assessments, and relevant regulatory sections (IND, IMPD, IB)
  • Actively contributing to the development of the department in line with GRD and GRD R&D strategic goals, sharing knowledge, and best practices.

You will need to have

  • Minimum MSc in relevant field (biotechnology, biology, biochemistry or a related field)
  • 5-10 years of of experience in the biotech/pharmaceutical industry, with exposure to gene editing, CGT/ATMPs, nucleic acid-based products and lipid nano particles development,
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Cell-based assays and potency method development for gene editing platforms and/ or mRNA–LNP products and delivery-driven potency assays (critical requirement)
    • Advanced Bioanalytical Techniques, i.e. Cell-based assays (flow cytometry, reporter assays), Gene editing readouts, ligand binding assays, protein expression/quantification assays.
    • Statistical tools for assay performance
    • Bridging assays and reference standard qualification
    • Analytical method development, validation, and product characterization
    • Control strategy development for complex biologics
  • Proven experience managing outsourced analytical development activities (CROs/CDMOs), including:
    • Technical oversight, ensuring scientifically rigorous assay execution, data integrity and reproducibility
    • Troubleshooting and escalation management
    • Critical, data-driven performance follow-up
  • Solid understanding of GMP, regulatory requirements, and CMC development lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Strong skills in technical writing, data review, and regulatory documentation.
  • Excellent problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, pragmatic, and results-driven approach.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment.

ABOUT QUANTUMLOOPAI

QuantumLoopAI is one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies. Our AI-powered platform, EMMA, is used by hundreds of organisations across the UK to manage communications, automate workflows and deliver better outcomes through intelligent automation. Backed by leading investors and scaling rapidly ahead of our Series A, we are building the infrastructure that will define the next generation of AI-driven service delivery.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.

You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where your testing directly protects real users.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Backend and Frontend Test Automation

  • Build and maintain automated test coverage across backend services and the frontend, ensuring new features ship without breaking existing behaviour.
  • Integrate tests into CI pipelines so quality checks run automatically on every change.
  • Work with engineers to turn real-world failures into permanent regression tests.

Voice Pipeline and Call Automation

  • Build and run outbound-call automation that places test calls through the live voice pipeline, simulates realistic caller scenarios, and validates the platform's behaviour from start to finish.
  • Test the speech-to-text (STT) layer — measuring transcription accuracy and how reliably the platform understands callers.
  • Test the text-to-speech (TTS) layer — validating pronunciation, naturalness, and that the voice output behaves correctly.
  • Run regression testing across multiple conversation flows and catch behavioural drift after changes.

Quality Evaluation and Defect Management

  • Evaluate calls against conversational quality dimensions — accuracy, tone, flow adherence, understanding, hand-off between stages, summaries, outcome handling, call control, and avoiding unnecessary repetition.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects through to resolution, writing clear reproduction steps from real call examples.
  • Work with engineers, prompt authors, and the operations team to identify quality issues and build permanent test coverage around them.

Requirements

ESSENTIAL

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation or software testing with a strong automation focus.
  • Strong hands-on Python — you write, debug and maintain test scripts daily, not occasionally.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated test suites across both API and UI layers.
  • Comfortable testing REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON).
  • Experience with automated web and UI testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with version-control workflows (Git) and continuous-integration pipelines — you have integrated automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Solid grasp of QA methodology — test design, regression strategy, and the defect lifecycle.
  • Excellent attention to detail and clear written communication.
  • Comfortable working remotely and aligning to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

DESIRABLE

  • Exposure to voice or conversational AI testing — metrics such as transcription accuracy (WER), naturalness scoring, or response latency.
  • Experience with automated or AI-assisted response evaluation.
  • Telephony or real-time audio and voice testing experience.
  • Experience working with data to gather and verify test evidence programmatically.
  • Experience in regulated software environments where quality assurance and compliance processes are important.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones.

LOGISTICS

  1. Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.
  2. Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).
  3. Start date: Flexible.

Benefits

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive package depending on experience
  • Potential share options
  • Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support
  • The opportunity to own test automation for a live voice AI platform at one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies
  • Remote working with a collaborative, high-ownership engineering culture
  • Direct collaboration with engineering, AI/ML and product teams

HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT

At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is building AI-powered products used by hundreds of organisations across the UK. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:

  • Impact over optics. We measure success by real outcomes, not busy work
  • Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context
  • Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our platform
  • Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment

This is a QA role where your work has direct, visible impact. Every test you build protects real users in real conversations. You will not be writing test scripts in isolation — you will be listening to real calls, diagnosing real failures, and building the automation that prevents them from happening again.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.

RECRUITMENT SAFETY NOTICE

QuantumLoopAI will never ask candidates for payment or sensitive financial information during the recruitment process. All official communications come from @quantumloopai.com email addresses.

COME WORK WITH US

Ready to own quality for a live voice AI platform? We would love to hear from you. Questions about this role? Contact

Job Title: Senior Research and Evaluation Manager (SREM)

Term position – 18 months

Reports To: Interim Director Research and Evaluation

New/Replacement Position:New Position

Location: Remote (within the United States)

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary Range: $84,000 - $98,000

About the Organization

The National Recreation and Park Association (NRPA) is the leading not-for-profit organization dedicated to building strong, healthy, and resilient communities through the power of parks and recreation. NRPA advances this vision by investing in and championing the work of park and recreation professionals as a catalyst for positive change in service of equity, climate-readiness, and overall health and well-being.

With more than 60,000 members, NRPA champions and supports the work of park and recreation professionals and advocates through professional development, grants and programs, research, publications, conferences, advocacy and more.

For more information, visit.

For digital access to NRPA’s flagship publication, Parks & Recreation, visit.

Job Overview

Collaborates and leads the production of research (40%) and evaluation (60%) deliverables. Produces meaningful park and recreation research focused on projects spanning diverse themes with an underlying goal of improving park and recreation agencies and increasing exposure of their good works by leading the written and verbal communication of public-facing research findings and other deliverables and collaborating with the Senior Research Manager and Interim Director of Research and Evaluation to develop and maintain research production plans for new and repeating data collection efforts. Measures short-term results and long-term impact of NRPA grant programs and collaborates on tools and guidance to strengthen the evaluation skills of stakeholders inside and outside of the organization (e.g., NRPA members). The SREM works closely with the Senior Research Manager and the Senior Evaluation Manager to ensure that deliverables are meeting department standards, aligned with the department and association vision and strategic plan, and scheduled and executed efficiently and with high quality.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate with the Senior Research Manager on the creation, analysis and reporting of all research-generated member surveys.
  • Lead efforts to write and present research findings for varying audiences in the form of reports, magazine articles, academic journals, blog posts, conference presentations and other avenues in accordance with department, organization, and industry standards.
  • Provide input and feedback on all research-related deliverables.
  • Collaborate with multiple departments to ensure internal and external surveys and forms are standardized and reflect NRPA’s approved language and intent.
  • Create and execute measurement plans that assess the progress and long-term impact of NRPA grant programs. This responsibility includes developing evaluation plans and key project metrics for concept papers and grant applications. For some projects, the SREM will develop a full evaluation framework, including identification of methodology, process and outcome measures, data collection methods and sources, and timelines. For other projects, the candidate will identify and manage relationships with outside consultants that serve as the primary investigators.
  • Communicate evaluation findings (written and verbal) to the research and evaluation team, program managers, funding partners, NRPA management and other key stakeholders. This includes working with internal and external stakeholders on written reports and dashboards appropriate for a diverse audience of members, funders, and partners.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of diversity, equity and inclusion concepts, is able to represent those in external relationships, and ensures that they are reflected in the programs and activities for which they are responsible.
  • Seek new methodologies and other innovations for evaluating the impact of NRPA’s grants in communities and the overall impact of NRPA.
  • Collaborate with the research and evaluation department staff members to create standard operating procedures and policies that improve its ability to reduce bias and support diversity, equity, and inclusion in all data-related efforts.
  • Represent NRPA at conferences, meetings, and site visits with local park and recreation agencies.
  • Support research and evaluation membership booth and other NRPA annual conference activities, as needed.
  • Undertake special projects and assignments as directed.

Qualifications

  • In lieu of specific educational requirements, professional experience, accomplishments, and industry knowledge will be highly regarded.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 6-9 years in related field (research/evaluation, statistical analysis, technical writing); 1-3 years of supervisory experience preferred; Association or P&R experience preferred.
  • Full life-cycle program evaluation experience a strong plus.
  • Strong knowledge and experience of quantitative and qualitative research methods and approaches.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to synthesize and present data and research findings clearly and concisely to a diverse audience. Strong experience and enthusiasm for non-academic writing for trade or membership organizations a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Suite required. Strong experience and skills with online survey software (e.g. Qualtrics, Alchemer); data analysis software such as SPSS (Custom Tables and Syntax a plus), GIS software (ESRI), and data visualization (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI) are strongly preferred.
  • Superior project and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities. Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Robust collaboration skills with internal and external partners.
  • Committed to working collaboratively with a wide diversity of colleagues and inspired to be a contributing member of an inclusive work culture.
  • Willing to travel up to 20 days per year.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

This position can be remote anywhere in the US with a preference in Santa Clara, Plano, Reston, or New York.

Product / Partnership Strategy and Execution:

  • Collaborate with PM as a peer in defining the product strategy and own the partnership strategy and execution plan.Consistently articulates understanding of customer needs and wants through research and identifies large and ambiguous problem statements to drive outcomes. The person should be able to clearly craft value for the customer,value for the partner and value for Palo Alto Networks.

  • Own the partnership roadmap, technical and business plan. Collaborate with TME and engineering in building technology value propositions, demos with partners

  • Drive pricing,design and architecture discussions with PM as a peer with the ability to influence and pivot the product roadmap within Palo Alto Networks and the ISV partner

  • Creates market positioning for the joint solution with the partner; leverages AI to test positioning and implications; independently advocates and differentiates to lead the market with a joint solution

  • Proactively sets challenging solution goals for Palo Alto Networks and the partner, aligns partners on tradeoffs, and drives cross-functional decisions to execution with clear ownership and accountability.Builds trust and relationships, understands motivations, and influences through collaboration and evidence to align teams on key decisions. Role will involve working with product counsel, legal teams that support partnerships,marketing.

  • Demonstrates cross-domain mastery and manages tradeoff decisions to address technical debt and sustain long-term feature velocity across solutions. This will be crucial in working with ISV partners and frontier model providers as the person will need to be the bridge between multiple product management teams on the Palo Alto Networks side and the partner side

  • Influences senior leaders at Palo Alto Networks and the partner without authority by navigating resistance through strategic persuasion and empathy, aligning stakeholders on priorities, decisions, and execution commitments.

Solution Architecture & Technical Blueprints

A core deliverable of this role is the continuous creation of architecture artifacts that make Prisma AIRS tangible and deployable for partners and their customers.

  • Data driven Builder: Synthesizes complex data into decision-ready narratives for solution vision and strategy tailored to each audience, securing clear next steps and owners.

  • Architecture Design: Design comprehensive architecture diagrams and detailed technical blueprints for secure AI deployments across cloud, data center, and hybrid environments.

  • Prisma AIRS Insertion Points: Identify and document critical insertion points for the full Prisma AIRS portfolio AI Model Security, AI Red Teaming, AI Runtime Security, and AI Agent Security within partner-built AI solutions.

  • Tech Stack Navigation: Navigate and map typical GSI AI tech stacks including LLMs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), MCP servers, and cloud-native AI services to design seamless AIRS integration patterns.

  • Rapid Technology Mastery: Demonstrate an exceptional ability to learn new and emerging technologies quickly, translating nascent capabilities — such as new inference providers or evolving agentic frameworks — into actionable architecture patterns.

  • Leads cross-domain innovation to enable product growth, aligning teams on experiments, delivery, and measurable customer outcomes at scale. This is a crucial capability as some of the partners would have portfolios that overlap with Palo Alto Networks. Helping product,GTM and partner leadership take the right decision in building a joint solution will require significant cross business unit and cross domain work

Joint Use Cases & Technical Value Propositions

Drive partner adoption by creating scalable, reusable technical assets that articulate the value of Prisma AIRS within the context of partner solutions.

  • Use Case Development: Create compelling, scenario-based use cases that demonstrate how GSIs, consulting firms, and technology ISVs can integrate and embed Prisma AIRS into their managed services, platforms, and customer-facing solutions.

  • Joint Value Propositions: Build joint technical value propositions with partners connecting partner AI capabilities to Prisma AIRS security outcomes covering prompt injection prevention, data leakage protection, AI agent security, and model vulnerability defense.

  • ISV & Platform Integration: Engage technology ISV partners such as ServiceNow and NVIDIA ecosystem partners to identify and productize integration patterns that embed Prisma AIRS natively within their platforms.

  • Partner Enablement: Deliver technical workshops, architecture reviews, and enablement sessions with GSI and consulting firm technical teams to build partner-side Prisma AIRS expertise at scale.

Joint Reference Architectures & Lighthouse Customers

Turn partner integrations into repeatable, customer-proven patterns that the broader ecosystem can adopt.

  • Reference Architecture Development: Build joint reference architectures co-developed with GSI and ISV partners, grounded in real-world deployment patterns, that serve as the definitive blueprint for secure AI adoption using Prisma AIRS.

  • Lighthouse Customer Engagement: Work directly with lighthouse customers alongside partner teams to validate reference architectures in production environments, creating case studies and proof points that accelerate broader market adoption.

  • Customer Conviction: Articulate the technical and business value of Prisma AIRS to both deeply technical engineering teams and executive stakeholders at partner organizations and their end customers.

  • Scalable Assets: Package validated architectures, POC scripts, and deployment guides into repeatable, self-service assets that partner technical teams can leverage independently.

Design & Build

This role requires the rare ability to both design and build translating complex AI security architectures into clear, compelling visual artifacts that GSI, Consulting, and ISV partners can immediately understand, present to their customers, and act upon. The ability to make the complex simple through great visual communication is as important as the technical depth behind it.

  • Technical Architecture Diagrams: Design and produce detailed, publication-quality architecture diagrams that illustrate how Prisma AIRS integrates within partner AI solutions. Diagrams must be clear enough for a GSI architect to present directly to an enterprise customer without additional explanation.

  • Lucidchart & Google Slides Proficiency: Expert-level use of Lucidchart for architecture diagrams and Google Slides for executive-ready technical presentations. Ability to build layered, visually clean diagrams that work equally well in a partner boardroom and a technical deep-dive.

  • Visualizing Complex Architectures: Translate multi-layer AI system architectures spanning inference infrastructure, orchestration frameworks, data pipelines, and security controls into clear, logical visual flows that non-specialist audiences at GSI, Consulting, and ISV partners can grasp and champion internally.

  • Partner-Ready Visual Assets: Build a library of reusable architecture templates, slide decks, and diagram components tailored to each partner type GSI delivery teams, consulting practice leads, and ISV platform architects so that Prisma AIRS integration patterns are easy to adopt, customize, and embed in partner proposals.

  • Python Development: Write, review, and maintain Python scripts and integration code that demonstrate Prisma AIRS capabilities, automate security configurations, and power functional proof-of-concepts.

  • AI Inferencing: Configure and test AI inference pipelines using platforms such as NVIDIA NIM, Together.ai, and major cloud inference services, integrating Prisma AIRS security controls at each layer.

  • Proof-of-Concept Delivery: Build end-to-end technical POCs that demonstrate secure AI interactions, prompt injection detection, data loss prevention, and AI agent behavior monitoring and document them visually so partners can replicate and extend the work.

  • API & Gateway Configuration: Configure AI gateways and integrate Prisma AIRS APIs within partner technology environments to validate real-world deployment scenarios.

Strategic Advisory & Field Intelligence

  • Subject Matter Expertise: Act as the internal and external authority on AI security architectures, representing Palo Alto Networks in executive partner meetings, industry forums, and technical advisory sessions.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Translate field observations from partner deployments and customer engagements into actionable feedback for Prisma AIRS product and engineering teams.

  • Market Intelligence: Monitor emerging AI technologies, new inferencing platforms, and evolving agentic frameworks to ensure Prisma AIRS insertion strategies remain current and ahead of the market.

CRITICAL KNOWLEDGE AREAS

Prisma AIRS & Palo Alto Networks Platform Essential

  • Prisma AIRS Portfolio: Deep knowledge of AI Model Security, AI Red Teaming, AI Runtime Security, and AI Agent Security their capabilities, deployment models, and API interfaces.

  • Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW): Architecture, deployment patterns, and integration in data center, cloud, and hybrid environments. Understanding of how firewalls enforce policy for AI workloads.

  • CDSS (Cloud-Delivered Security Services): Familiarity with Threat Prevention, DNS Security, Advanced WildFire, and their applicability to protecting AI infrastructure and workloads.

  • AI Gateway Configuration: Inline security enforcement for LLM traffic, prompt inspection, response filtering, and integration with AIRS runtime controls.

AI & Inferencing Technologies Essential

  • NVIDIA: Hands-on knowledge of NIM microservices, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, and GPU-accelerated inference infrastructure and how to apply Prisma AIRS controls within these environments.

  • Inference Platforms: Experience with Together.ai, Neoclouds, and major cloud inference services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) including their API patterns and security considerations.

  • LLM Architectures: Prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector databases, embedding models, and fine-tuning workflows understanding both capability and attack surface.

  • Agentic Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) understanding agent-to-agent communication patterns and their security implications.

  • Python Scripting: Proficiency in writing integration scripts, automation tooling, API wrappers, and technical demonstrations in Python.

Partner Ecosystem & Security Fundamentals Important

  • GSI Technology Stacks: Deep familiarity with how Deloitte, Cognizant, NTT, Wipro, and similar firms architect and deliver AI solutions for enterprise clients.

  • Identity & Access Management in AI Workflows: Securing agent identities, service accounts, API key lifecycle management, and least-privilege access within agentic AI systems.

  • Cloud-Native AI Services: AWS, Azure, and GCP AI/ML services and their integration patterns with enterprise security controls.

PARTNER ECOSYSTEM SCOPE

This role spans four partner categories across the AI ecosystem:

Global System Integrators (GSIs) such as

  • Deloitte, Cognizant, NTT, IBM Consulting, Accenture

  • Focus: embedding Prisma AIRS into GSI-led AI delivery practices and managed security offerings

  • Focus: co-developing AI security frameworks and positioning Prisma AIRS within client transformation programs

Technology ISVs

  • ServiceNow, Glean, NVIDIA ecosystem partners, and enterprise AI platform providers

  • Focus: Productized integrations that embed Prisma AIRS natively within partner platforms

Frontier Model Providers

  • OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Mistral

  • Focus: Reference architectures and security blueprints for enterprise deployments of frontier models

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 10 + years in Product Management, Technology consulting, Solutions Architecture, Systems Engineering, or Technical Partner Management with a dedicated focus on AI/ML and/or cloud security architectures.

  • GSI & Consulting Background: Proven experience working at or in close partnership with major GSIs (Deloitte, Cognizant, NTT) and top-tier management consulting firms (McKinsey, BCG), with an understanding of how they architect and sell AI solutions.

  • AI Tech Stack Mastery: Deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI solution architectures including LLM integrations, AI gateways, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and vector databases.

  • Prisma AIRS & Platform Knowledge: Ability to rapidly master the Prisma AIRS portfolio. Prior knowledge of Palo Alto Networks firewalls and CDSS is critical.

  • Security Fundamentals: Strong understanding of data center security architectures including NGFW deployment, threat prevention, and securing AI workloads against prompt injection, insecure outputs, and model vulnerabilities.

  • Agent & Identity Security: Understanding of how to secure AI agents, enforce least-privilege access, and manage identity within complex AI workflows.

  • Technical Depth: Proficiency in Python scripting, API integrations, and inference platform configuration. Expert-level ability to create detailed architecture diagrams and executive presentations using Lucidchart, Google Slides, and equivalent tools.

  • Communication Excellence: Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical value propositions to both deeply technical engineers and C-level executive stakeholders.

  • Technology Passion: Deeply passionate about emerging AI architectures, new inferencing technologies, and driving innovation at the frontier of AI security.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.description:
Lead Video Editor

Transform raw footage into content that helps real estate agents win in their local markets

About Knwn Local

We're a creative agency on a mission: scale from 55 to 200+ YouTube channels while helping real estate agents become the most trusted voices in their markets. We build long-form video strategies that create real authority and drive actual business results.

The proof is in our growth:

  • Scaling fast from 55 to 200+ channels
  • Building systematic production operations that work at scale
  • Helping agents win deals through strategic content, not viral gimmicks

We believe in extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and beyond excellence. If that resonates, you'll thrive here.

We're hiring a Lead Editor to deliver high-quality edits consistently and help us maintain our quality standards across the team as we scale.

To Apply Now:

The Role

As a Lead Editor at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of video editors who transform raw real estate content into high-impact YouTube videos that help agents dominate their local markets. This is a player-coach leadership role where you'll spend 70-90% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 10-30% hands-on editing complex projects.

You'll own editing quality standards, team development, and operational excellence within your pod, partnering closely with Pod Managers, YouTube Managers, and Strategists to deliver retention-driven content at scale. Your success is measured not by how many videos you edit, but by how well your team performs, grows, and retains talent.

This role is perfect for someone who loves developing editors as much as editing itselfsomeone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying their impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, or purely hands-off without getting in the weeds of editing, this isn't the right fit.

To Apply Now:

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & Development (50% of role)

  • Manage and develop 25-50 video editors, conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill progression and performance (with the support of multiple Senior Editors & YouTube Managers)
  • Lead weekly team edit reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Lead monthly team trainings for the editing team culture & growth
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new editor hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for your team
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Participate in hiring (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring recommendations)
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with editors through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Implement skip-level check-ins to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Quality Standards & Systems (20-30% of role)

  • Own and evolve editing quality standards, style guides, and templates across your team
  • Establish QA processes that maintain >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors
  • Serve as final quality review and approval for complex or high-stakes edits before client delivery
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and retention analysis, translating data into actionable editing improvements
  • Create efficiency systems (templates, motion graphics libraries, workflow optimizations)
  • Build performance dashboards tracking team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention performance)
  • Drive continuous improvement through weekly "edit of the week" reviews and retrospectives

Strategic Collaboration (10-15% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Manager and YouTube Managers on content strategy and creative direction
  • Participate in Monthly Client Strategy Calls to present editing approach and performance insights
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with scriptwriters and designers to align on creative vision
  • Communicate proactively with leadership on team capacity, blockers, and resource needs
  • Contribute to quarterly planning and annual strategy with editing function perspective
  • Handle client escalations and quality issues with transparency and solutions-focused approach

Player-Coach Editing (10-20% of role)

  • Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per month for VIP clients or training demonstrations
  • Model excellence by staying hands-on with the craft and maintaining YouTube editing fluency
  • Stay current on YouTube editing trends, competitor content, and platform algorithm changes
  • Experiment with new techniques and tools, sharing learnings and innovations with the team
  • Maintain organized project files and asset management as an example for the team

Requirements

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional editing craft with proven leadership ability. You should be passionate about developing talent and building systems that multiply impact across a team, not just delivering great edits yourself.

Leadership & Management Experience

  • 5-7+ years of professional video editing experience with 2+ years managing or leading editors
  • Proven track record developing and scaling editing teams of 4+ people
  • Experience hiring editors (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring decisions)
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • History of conducting performance reviews and managing accountability (including difficult conversations)
  • Experience building onboarding programs, training materials, and documented workflows
  • Comfortable with the full people management cycle: hiring, coaching, performance management, and when necessary, firing

Technical Mastery (You Can Teach Others)

  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro - you can troubleshoot complex technical issues and teach advanced techniques
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects
  • Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve, Blender, or other tools (or quick learner)
  • Deep understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, storytelling, and algorithm optimization
  • Ability to QA others' work and identify issues across editing style, technical execution, and brand consistency
  • Portfolio showcasing both your own work AND examples of team development (before/after of editors you've coached)

Systems & Process Thinking

  • Experience building scalable editing workflows, style guides, and template systems
  • Understanding of capacity planning and resource allocation for editing teams
  • Ability to create performance dashboards and track team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention)
  • Skilled at documentation - SOPs, training materials, and knowledge management
  • Process optimization mindset - constantly looking for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality
  • Experience with project management tools (Asana, Notion, Frame.io) and team collaboration systems

Strategic & Business Acumen

  • Ability to translate business objectives into editing strategy and creative direction
  • Comfortable presenting to clients and defending creative decisions with data and performance insights
  • Understanding of editing team economics (capacity planning, turnaround times, quality vs. speed tradeoffs)
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with strategists, writers, designers, and YouTube managers
  • Can navigate ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information
  • Thinks beyond individual edits to how editing impacts channel growth and client business results

Communication & Influence

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and team documentation
  • Ability to give direct, constructive feedback that motivates rather than demoralizes
  • Skilled at managing up (keeping leadership informed), across (collaborating with peers), and down (developing direct reports)
  • Proactive communication style - you flag capacity issues, quality concerns, and team challenges before they become crises
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, client escalations, conflict resolution)
  • Can translate technical editing concepts into language that non-editors understand

Work Style & Mindset

  • Player-coach mentality - willing to stay hands-on with editing (10-20% of time) while primarily focusing on team leadership
  • Excellent organizational skills managing both your own work and your team's project pipeline
  • Ability to balance competing priorities: team development, quality standards, client deadlines, and strategic initiatives
  • Comfortable context-switching between hands-on editing, team coaching, client calls, and strategic planning
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are constantly evolving
  • Gets energized by developing talent and seeing team members succeed

Cultural Leadership

  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; models this for direct reports
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to consistently exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of issues
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development, not personal recognition

Results You'll Drive

Team Performance

  • Your editing team consistently maintains >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors
  • Editor retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New editors productive at 80% capacity within 60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Systems

  • Zero client escalations due to editing quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Editing workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Average video retention improves 5-10% year-over-year through data-driven editing strategies

Strategic Impact

  • Editing function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with editing insights that drive performance
  • Your team supports clients publishing 4+ videos per month consistently
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for editing quality and communication
  • At least 1-2 editors promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship

Player-Coach Excellence

  • Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per week as benchmarks and training examples
  • Your edits consistently achieve 8-10% average retention (above platform benchmarks)
  • Model extreme ownership, excellence, and proactive curiosity through your work

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Salary: $36,000 - $60,000 USD annually (based on experience and team size managed)

What We Offer:

  • Fully Remote
  • Flexible Time Off policy (we trust you to manage your time and energy)
  • Annual Holiday Breaks
  • Leadership development program
  • Access to industry-leading tools, plugins, and AI-assisted editing software
  • Opportunities to earn Monthly wellness allowance, Home office stipend, Professional development budget &/or Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period)
  • Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria

REAL TALK:

This is an early-stage startup scaling rapidly. You'll face challenges - processes break, priorities shift, and things get messy. We need people who are resilient, resourceful, and committed long-term.

But if you want to:

  • Build a world-class editing team and multiply your impact 10x
  • Develop editors and watch them grow beyond their potential
  • Help America's top real estate leaders dominate their local markets
  • Build something meaningful from 55 to 200+ channels

This is the place.

This role is player-coach (10-25% hands-on editing, 75%+ leadership). If you want to focus purely on editing without managing people, this isn't the right fit.

Location

Remote-first,

Our Core Values

Extreme Ownership Take responsibility for your work and outcomes. No excuses, just solutions.

Beyond Excellence Care about the details. Deliver work that exceeds expectations.

Proactive Curiosity Don't wait to be told. Ask questions, identify problems, suggest solutions.

Mission Focus Remember: your edits help real estate agents build their businesses. That matters.

Ready to Apply Now?

We primarily look at those who apply above.

Pay $36K - $60K+ USD a year (depending on experience)

Job Description:

GDIT has an opportunity for a dynamic and talented candidate to join our team supporting the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AOUSC) Case Management Systems Office (CMSO) in its modernization effort for one of its mission-critical case management application that is used by all U.S. district, appellate, and bankruptcy courts’ staff members and external stakeholders. CMSO has a mature agile practice using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and supports a broad range of complex business systems which are instrumental to the AOUSC mission.

The Sr. Scrum Master will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Establish goals and plans that meet Program Increment (PI) objectives.
  • Coach technical teams and Product Owners basic to advanced Agile concepts including Epic and User Story creation, Scrum, and Kanban.
  • Manage expectations with multiple Product Owners (PO).
  • Interact in client negotiations and interfacing with senior management.
  • Provide leadership on major tasks or technology assignments.
  • Facilitate horizontal and vertical communication across team members to identify dependencies and risks that may prevent team progress, and provide mitigation plans as needed.
  • Organize and facilitate SCRUM ceremonies: daily standups, Sprint Planning/Grooming, Sprint Reviews/Demos, and Retrospectives.
  • Maintain JIRA and other information radiators for the teams.
  • Mentor and coach team members on core Agile values, principles, practices, and processes
  • Enable team to become self-organizing and self-managing to achieve its goals.
  • Work with the Product Management team to develop release plans and ensure product backlogs are well-groomed, prioritized, and visible to all stakeholders.
  • Motivate teams to perform and ensure team members are collectively responsible for all aspects of the committed work (analysis, development, testing, documentation, etc.).
  • Identify, address, and communicate project risks, dependencies, and team impediments.
  • Ensure the team’s “definition of done” is well defined on the story, sprint, and release levels.
  • Facilitate productivity through discussion, decision making, and conflict resolution.
  • Shield the team from external interferences.
  • Assist with internal and external communication and improving transparency.
  • Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised with an emphasis on problem solving.
  • Assess the Scrum maturity of the team and coach the team to higher levels of maturity at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team.
  • Coach a continuous improvement mindset and recommend adjustments to established delivery practices.
  • Participate in Scrum of Scrum meetings to ensure cross-team collaboration and coordination of release plans and integration of testing activities.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with all stakeholders, including customers.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree plus at least five (5+) years of experience in Agile development environment.
  • Experience with using and implementing the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and work rapidly in a high tempo environment that often requires multitasking.
  • Experience with software development or working in software development organization.
  • Ability to create, sustain, and enhance fostering of team dynamics and collaboration.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Agile Certified Scrum Master (PMI-ACP).
  • Effective influence, collaboration, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify win-win solutions.

•Effective facilitation skills.

  • Effective coaching and mentoring skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communications skills.
  • Energetic, goal oriented, detailed oriented, proactive, innovative, hardworking, and patient.

jobs.description:
Success Manager (Client Success, Cold Email & Startup Operations) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, with client meetings across U.S. time zones

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Success Manager to own the entire post-sale client experience—from onboarding and campaign execution to client retention, satisfaction, and long-term success.

This is not a project management role.

You’ll be fully accountable for client outcomes, campaign performance, and delivery quality while working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities evolve quickly and ownership is expected.

You’ll partner closely with the founder, developers, and outreach team to ensure cold email campaigns consistently deliver results while building scalable client success processes as the company grows.

If you thrive in startups, enjoy solving complex client challenges, and understand both the strategic and technical side of cold email operations, this role is an excellent fit.

What You’ll Own

Client Success & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of 20–30 active clients.
  • Lead onboarding calls, strategy sessions, and recurring client meetings.
  • Build trusted relationships with founders and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage client expectations through proactive communication.
  • Identify risks early and implement strategies to prevent churn.
  • Own long-term client satisfaction, retention, and account health.

Campaign Performance & Optimization

  • Review, diagnose, and improve underperforming cold email campaigns.
  • Troubleshoot:
    • Deliverability issues
    • Inbox placement
    • Domain health
    • Prospect list quality
    • Email copy performance
  • Perform quality assurance before campaign launches.
  • Continuously optimize campaigns to improve client outcomes.
  • Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements proactively.

Processes, Documentation & Delivery

  • Build and improve client delivery documentation as the business scales.
  • Develop practical playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Track:
    • SLAs
    • Client health
    • Delivery quality
    • Operational standards
  • Help establish scalable systems that support company growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with developers to resolve technical and infrastructure issues.
  • Coordinate closely with outreach specialists on campaign execution.
  • Report directly to the founder on:
    • Client health
    • Delivery performance
    • Risks
    • Opportunities for improvement
  • Align internal teams to ensure exceptional client outcomes.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’ve worked in fast-growing startups where adaptability and ownership are essential.
  • You take responsibility for results instead of waiting for perfect processes.
  • You communicate confidently with founders, executives, and technical teams.
  • You enjoy solving operational problems and improving systems.
  • You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Experience leading:
    • Client Success
    • Client Delivery
    • Operations
    • Account Management
  • Experience in startups or early-stage companies.
  • Background in:
    • Cold email agencies
    • Lead generation
    • Outbound sales environments

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on expertise in:
    • Cold email strategy
    • Deliverability
    • Inbox warm-up
    • Email copywriting
    • List quality optimization
  • Ability to write and optimize cold email copy.
  • Understanding of:
    • APIs
    • Automation workflows
    • Data integrations
  • Daily practical use of AI tools to improve operational efficiency.

Communication & Leadership

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English.
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and leadership teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience using:
    • Instantly
    • Smartlead
    • Apollo
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
  • Familiarity with startup scaling and operational process development.
  • Experience building client success playbooks and delivery frameworks.
  • Background in B2B SaaS or service-based businesses.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Meet with clients to review campaign performance.
  • Analyze campaign metrics and troubleshoot issues.
  • Improve deliverability, messaging, and campaign strategy.
  • Coordinate with developers and outreach teams on campaign execution.
  • Monitor client health and proactively address risks.
  • Build documentation and improve internal delivery processes.
  • Report progress and insights directly to the founder.

In short: You own client success from onboarding through retention, ensuring campaigns perform, clients stay satisfied, and delivery operations scale efficiently alongside company growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Client retention and reduced churn.
  • Cold email campaign performance.
  • Deliverability and inbox placement improvements.
  • Client satisfaction and relationship health.
  • SLA compliance and delivery consistency.
  • Overall impact on client growth and business outcomes.

Why Join Us?

  • High ownership over client success and delivery.
  • Work directly with the founder in a fast-growing startup.
  • Shape scalable client success processes from the ground up.
  • Blend client strategy, operations, and technical problem-solving.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Head of Client Success
    • Director of Client Delivery
    • Operations Lead
    • Chief of Staff
    • Customer Success Director

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Founder Interview
  4. Final Discussion
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about client success, understand cold email strategy and deliverability, enjoy solving operational challenges, and thrive in fast-moving startup environments, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and play a key role in helping clients achieve measurable results while shaping the future of a growing business.

Job Title

Remote Applications Specialist (Patient Monitoring)

Job Description

Remote Applications Specialist (Patient Monitoring)

As an experienced Remote Clinical Applications Support Specialist, you will leverage your nursing clinical education/training to be responsible for providing telephone and remote clinical application support to internal and external customers for our Patient Care Monitoring Systems (PCMS) team. In this role, you will not only assist in resolving customer clinical inquiries and problems, but you will also participate in an on-call rotation afterhours support program - as part of a shared team effort.


Your role:


  • Delivers end-to-end clinical application support for patient monitoring solutions, including providing telephone-based and remote support to internal and external customers, troubleshooting complex clinical application issues using advanced remote access technologies, and managing escalations through to resolution. Provides on-site support during critical customer situations as needed, takes ownership of issue resolution, and drives improved customer satisfaction and company profitability through timely, effective problem resolution.
  • Drives operational excellence and performance accountability by ensuring accurate and timely submission of individual scorecards, maintaining complete and precise data entry within required systems, and utilizing call center tools to monitor responsiveness and meet service level expectations. Effectively manages company assets—including training, tools, equipment, travel, and expenses—in alignment with company policies while contributing structured feedback and product improvement recommendations to the product management group.
  • Serves as a clinical subject matter expert and collaborative team partner, acting as a key resource to support team objectives and deliver a consistent, positive company image in all customer interactions. Assesses complex clinical issues, gathers and analyzes data, and partners with Technical Support Engineers to define and execute action plans through to resolution. Actively shares knowledge with peers and internal stakeholders to strengthen team capability and improve overall service delivery.
  • Supports continuous improvement and professional development initiatives by contributing to knowledge-based tools, completing all required product and clinical training (TEDs), and ensuring alignment with evolving product capabilities and customer needs. Takes ownership of individual development planning in partnership with leadership, proactively identifying growth opportunities and enhancing expertise to drive higher levels of impact and performance.

You're the right fit if:


  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Nursing or Medical Technology required. Must be registered and in good standing with appropriate credentialing body.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of clinical experience preferred.
  • A minimum of three (3) years of experience in a clinical phone support environment preferred.
  • Excellent customer service, communication, multi-tasking and prioritization, and ability to work with minimal supervision required.
  • Advanced knowledge of clinical applications within Patient Monitoring.
  • Scheduled on-call availability will be required.

jobs.description:
FUTURESEARCH builds AI that predicts the future.

We are looking for people with a proven track record and a keen interest in AI to join our mission to radically scale and improve human understanding of the present and future, enabling better decision making during the arrival of transformative AI.

We are an elite team of engineers and researchers at the frontier of AI epistemics. Some of our most consequential work comes from people who would call themselves neither. We have the best publicly available forecaster, with a public track record in forecasting tournaments at and . We publish papers, such as our ICLR Workshop paper in Jan 2026, and benchmarks like Deep Research Bench and Bench to the Future. We work with frontier labs on research, evaluation, and training.

The work here moves with the frontier itself, so the chance to do something remarkable comes around often. That also means you will regularly be handed things you have never done before. One of our research scientists made a game-changing improvement to our forecaster, and then created the marketing video to promote it. Our engineers design evals, our chief of staff builds internal automations with LLMs, and everyone runs our own forecaster on questions they actually care about.

In a world where skills that used to take years to acquire now take weeks to pick up, we hire for what can't be taught. These are the characteristics you default to when nobody has told you what to do. We look for people who care deeply about the collective work of the company, who step up to fill in when the person who assigned the work is unreachable, who stay meticulous when things are frantic, and who bring a proposed solution to every problem they raise. If you tend to pick up whatever the problem in front of you requires, you're exactly who this posting is for.

We hire on demonstrated work rather than titles. The strongest applications point at artifacts. That might be a forecasting bot or a track record of careful public predictions, a benchmark or a dataset, an analysis that changed a real decision, a program you designed and ran and can show the results of, or a tool other people still rely on. The one thing every role here shares is that it produces something you can point at, so if your strengths are more tailored to coordinating or representing deliverables rather than producing them, the work here will frustrate you. Whatever your background, you should be comfortable working with data and numbers, and eager to let AI take you past what your title says you can do.

We read every application and route you to the interview process that fits your strengths.

We are fully remote. SF and London are our primary in-person locations. We have flexible hours.

Benefits

FutureSearch is fully remote. SF, NYC, and London are our primary in-person locations, and we travel to meet 4-6 times a year. We have flexible hours, and operate in a high trust environment.

Our salary range is $125,000 to $225,000, varying primarily by country. We offer higher-than-average equity. You should expect a total compensation package that is near the top for any seed-stage startup, with large room to grow.

We offer full benefits, varying based on your country, including: healthcare, paternity/maternity leave, equipment, and travel expenses.
