JLL is seeking an accomplished Scheduler to support scheduling operations for mission-critical projects and facilities. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining detailed project schedules, conducting schedule analysis, and coordinating with project teams to ensure timely delivery of capital projects and facility improvements.

The Scheduler works on complex assignments requiring considerable judgment and initiative in applying scheduling principles and methodologies. You'll develop critical path schedules, monitor project progress, analyze schedule performance, and communicate schedule status to project stakeholders. Working independently with general supervision, you'll apply advanced scheduling knowledge to support successful project delivery while collaborating with cost managers, project managers, design teams, and contractors. This position requires strong technical proficiency in scheduling software combined with analytical skills to identify schedule risks and support project decision-making for mission-critical capital projects valued up to $1B+.


What your day-to-day will look like:

Schedule Development and Maintenance

• Develop detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 or similar scheduling software for assigned capital projects

• Establish work breakdown structures (WBS) and activity coding systems that align with project requirements and organizational standards

• Define activity durations, logic relationships, constraints, and dependencies based on input from project teams, contractors, and design professionals

• Incorporate procurement milestones, long-lead equipment deliveries, and critical approval processes into project schedules

• Create baseline schedules upon project authorization and maintain version control throughout project lifecycle

• Update project schedules regularly based on actual progress, incorporating changes in scope, sequencing, or resource availability

• Develop look-ahead schedules (2-week, 4-week, 3-month) to support short-term planning and coordination activities

• Coordinate schedule inputs from multiple trade contractors and design disciplines to ensure comprehensive schedule integration

Critical Path Analysis and Schedule Performance Monitoring

• Conduct critical path analysis to identify activities with zero or negative float that drive overall project completion

• Perform total float analysis to assess schedule flexibility and prioritize activities requiring management attention

• Monitor schedule performance by comparing actual progress to planned progress and baseline schedules

• Calculate schedule performance metrics including Schedule Performance Index (SPI) and schedule variance

• Identify schedule trends, potential delays, and activities falling behind planned progress

• Analyze impacts of scope changes, design revisions, or unforeseen conditions on project schedule and critical path

• Evaluate "what-if" scenarios to assess alternative sequencing strategies or recovery options

• Track milestone achievements and forecast completion dates for key project deliverables

Schedule Reporting and Communication

• Prepare schedule status reports for assigned projects showing progress, critical path, upcoming activities, and milestone forecasts

• Generate visual schedule presentations including Gantt charts, milestone charts, and summary-level schedules for various audiences

• Communicate schedule status, potential delays, and critical issues to project managers and project teams

• Participate in project meetings and present schedule updates, addressing questions from project stakeholders

• Provide schedule information and data for monthly project reports and client status updates

• Coordinate with cost management team to support integrated cost and schedule reporting

• Prepare schedule narratives explaining variances, schedule changes, and recommended actions

• Escalate significant schedule risks or delays to project manager or senior scheduling staff with supporting analysis

Schedule Coordination and Integration

• Coordinate schedule development with project managers, design teams, contractors, and commissioning agents

• Facilitate schedule coordination meetings to align activities across multiple contractors or project phases

• Ensure proper sequencing and logic ties between design, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities

• Identify and resolve schedule conflicts between interdependent activities or trade contractors

• Coordinate schedule inputs from specialty consultants including MEP engineers, commissioning agents, and testing firms

• Support integration of design-build or fast-track delivery schedules with overall project timeline

• Align schedule milestones with funding availability, approval processes, and occupancy requirements

Schedule Risk Identification and Analysis

• Identify schedule risks and constraints that could impact project timelines

• Assess potential impacts of identified risks on critical path and project completion dates

• Support development of schedule mitigation strategies and contingency plans in coordination with project teams

• Monitor risk triggers and track effectiveness of implemented mitigation measures

• Analyze weather impacts, holiday shutdowns, and other calendar-related factors affecting schedule performance

• Evaluate resource constraints, material availability, and other factors that could cause schedule delays

• Document schedule assumptions, constraints, and risk factors in schedule narratives and reports

Schedule Quality and Compliance

• Follow established scheduling standards, methodologies, and templates provided by senior scheduling staff or project controls management

• Ensure schedules comply with contractual schedule requirements and client specifications

• Maintain schedule quality by validating logic relationships, checking for missing links, and ensuring reasonable activity durations

• Document schedule basis including assumptions, calendars, constraints, and productivity factors

• Maintain organized schedule files and documentation in accordance with project controls procedures

• Support schedule audits or reviews by providing requested documentation and addressing identified issues

• Implement feedback and recommendations from schedule quality reviews conducted by senior staff

Collaboration and Support

• Work closely with project managers to understand project objectives, constraints, and priorities

• Coordinate with cost managers to support earned value management and integrated project controls

• Support change order evaluation by analyzing schedule impacts of proposed scope changes

• Provide schedule data and analysis to support claims documentation or dispute resolution activities

• Collaborate with commissioning teams to develop and track commissioning and startup schedules

• Assist in developing project execution plans and schedule management plans as requested

• May provide guidance to junior scheduling staff or interns on scheduling techniques and software use

Continuous Improvement

• Stay current with scheduling software updates, new features, and best practices

• Participate in project controls team meetings and training sessions

• Contribute ideas for improving scheduling processes, templates, and efficiency

• Support implementation of scheduling technology tools and platforms as directed

• Learn from schedule performance on completed projects to improve estimating and planning approaches


Required qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or related field from an accredited institution

• 5-8 years of direct relevant experience in construction scheduling or project controls roles

• Strong proficiency in scheduling software including Primavera P6 (P6 EPPM or P6 Professional)

• Solid understanding of critical path method (CPM) scheduling principles and techniques

• Experience developing and maintaining schedules for capital construction projects valued at $500M-$5B

• Knowledge of construction methods, sequencing, and project delivery processes

• Strong analytical skills with ability to identify schedule trends, risks, and performance issues

• Effective written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports and presenting to project teams

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Ability to work independently with general supervision while managing multiple project assignments

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and commitment to accuracy

• Collaborative team player with ability to coordinate with diverse project stakeholders


Preferred qualifications:

• Planning and Scheduling Professional (PSP) certification from AACE International

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from PMI

• Experience with mission-critical, data center, healthcare, or laboratory facility projects

• Familiarity with additional scheduling tools (Microsoft Project, Asta Powerproject, schedule analysis software)

• Knowledge of earned value management (EVM) principles and applications

• Experience with design-build, CM-at-risk, or integrated project delivery methods

• Understanding of commissioning processes and startup schedules for complex building systems

• Experience with LEED projects or sustainable construction scheduling

• Exposure to BIM 4D scheduling or visual simulation techniques

• Professional membership in AACE International, PMI, or similar organizations

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

THE POSITION:

The AI Security Engineer I supports the security, governance, and responsible use of AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI technologies across EVERSANA. This role assists with securing AI-enabled applications, models, and data; conducting security assessments; monitoring emerging AI threats; and implementing security controls aligned with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.

Working closely with both IT and business stakeholders, the AI Security Engineer I helps ensure AI solutions are developed, deployed, and operated securely while enabling innovation and managing risk effectively.

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Document findings, recommendations, and remediation activities in accordance with established security and compliance processes.

Build your own estate agency business with the support of Nested

At Nested, we believe great estate agents deserve more freedom, more support and a greater share of the rewards they create.

Traditional agency can be an excellent place to learn your craft, but for many experienced agents, it can limit earning potential, flexibility and autonomy.

Our platform enables ambitious estate agents to build their own businesses under a trusted national brand, whilst benefiting from industry-leading technology, marketing support and an experienced HQ team who understand the realities of estate agency.

Whether you're an experienced negotiator, valuer, branch manager, or already operating independently, Nested provides the tools, support and community to help you grow a successful business in your local area.

Why Join Nested?

Keep More Of What You Earn

Unlike other self employed estate agency models, Nested allows agents to keep a significantly greater share of the revenue they generate. Starting at a 75/25 split, our commission structure is designed to reward growth and success, with agents able to earn up to 100% commission once their cap is reached.

Extensive HQ Support

Running your own business doesn't mean doing it alone.

From onboarding and compliance support through to marketing resources, operational assistance and ongoing training, our HQ team is on hand to help you focus on growing your business.

Modern Technology

Nested provides access to theCRM platform and technology suite designed to help agents manage their business efficiently, communicate effectively with clients and deliver an outstanding customer experience.

Income Support Package Available

We understand that transitioning into self-employment can be a significant step. For the right candidates, an income support package may be available to help you build momentum whilst establishing your pipeline.

The Opportunity

As a Self-Employed Estate Agent, you'll take ownership of building and growing your business within your chosen area.

You will be responsible for generating leads, conducting valuations, winning instructions, negotiating sales and managing clients throughout their property journey.

Unlike a traditional employed role, you'll have the freedom to decide how you work, where you work and how you grow your business, whilst benefiting from the support, systems and reputation of the Nested brand.

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Previous estate agency experience within the UK

  • Experience winning instructions and negotiating sales

  • Strong local market knowledge

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

  • A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset

  • A genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer service

Most importantly, we're looking for individuals who are motivated to build a successful business and provide exceptional outcomes for their clients.

About Nested

Nested is led by CEO Alice Bullard and supported by an experienced HQ team, many of whom have enjoyed successful careers within estate agency themselves.

We understand the challenges agents face because we've faced them too.

Our mission is simple: to help great estate agents build thriving businesses through better support, better technology and a better way of working.

⭐ We're proud to be rated 5 Stars on Trustpilot, reflecting our commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers.

jobs.excerpt: Hi!  I'm Donna, the Support Lead at Modash.  I'm looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.
jobs.description:
Hi! I'm Donna, the Support Lead at Modash.

I'm looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team. Here's a little background, examples of the things that you'll work on, and things you probably want to know.

Background & reason for hiring

Support at Modash isn’t just answering tickets. It’s how we deliver the best customer experience in the multiverse. You’ll be the first person customers talk to when something’s confusing, broken, or urgent, and you’ll make them feel taken care of fast.

We’re hiring a new Customer Support Specialist based in Canada to strengthen our coverage in North America and keep response times fast as Modash grows.

Your team is spread across Europe and North America: I am based in Ireland, Laurenis based in Canada, and Martine is based in Estonia. You’ll join a tight-knit Support team that takes full ownership of every issue and makes sure every customer feels heard, supported, and genuinely cared for.

Scope of the role & what you'll actually do

Your job is simple to explain and hard to do well: be the go-to support partner who helps customers solve the right problem (not just the fast one), and leaves them feeling confident using Modash.

You’ll spend most of your time in Intercom helping customers via chat + email (and sometimes live or async video when it’s the fastest way to help), and collaborating with the team to solve tricky cases.

  • Give practical advice on influencer marketing workflows and best practices.
  • Help customers understand how to use specific parts of Modash (with clear, step-by-step guidance)
  • Troubleshoot product issues: reproduce problems, ask good follow-up questions, and guide customers to a solution
  • Escalate bugs/issues with strong context (clear steps, examples, links, impact)
  • Keep our Help Center and internal documentation updated when you notice gaps or recurring confusion.⁠⁠
  • Contribute to customer communication during incidents (e.g., banners/updates) when needed.⁠⁠
  • Spot patterns and share customer feedback so we continuously build a better product

What success looks like

We’ll align on targets together, but success in this role usually looks like:

  • Strong first response time ~ under 2 hours.⁠⁠
  • Consistently solve the real problem (not just close the ticket).
  • Clean internal notes and handoffs, so anyone can pick up the case.
  • Help Center improvements shipped continuously based on real tickets.⁠

Requirements

  • You have 2+ years of experience in customer support (ideally in SaaS).
  • Your English is strong, both written and spoken.
  • You write clearly and kindly. You can explain complex things in simple words.
  • You’re comfortable troubleshooting: reproducing issues, asking good follow-up questions, and narrowing down the real cause.
  • You take ownership. You don’t drop threads, and you keep customers updated until the issue is resolved.
  • You can work without a perfect playbook. When something is unclear, you ask for help, figure it out, and help improve the process for next time.
  • You’re organised. You keep cases and handoffs clear, and you help turn repeat questions into reusable replies or clearer docs.
  • You stay calm under pressure and handle frustrated customers with care.

Nice-to-haves

    • Experience supporting influencer marketing or e-commerce tools.
    • Experience with technical support topics (integrations, tracking, APIs).
    • Experience making/helping maintain Help Center docs and internal processes.⁠

The tools you'll use

  • Intercom → primary support tool and customer comms hub
  • Notion → our internal knowledge base for everything Modash
  • Stripe → subscriptions, payments, and invoices
  • FullStory → session replays for debugging and understanding customer behaviour
  • Modash → reproduce customer issues, check account settings, and guide customers through features step-by-step

Working hours / schedule

Your typical schedule will be 10am–6pm Eastern time, Monday - Friday, with some weekend flexibility depending on coverage needs.

Benefits

  • Unlimited paid vacation time. If you're happy & well-rested, you'll do better work. Take the time you need to enjoy a balanced life.
  • Fully remote working. As long as you have a reliable internet connection, we want you to work wherever is best for you. At home, in a café, on a beach. Whatever works.
  • Personal development. When you grow, we benefit. If there's a course, book, or conference that will help you upskill - we'll cover it.
  • Ownership. You're the expert at what you do, and so you should have the flexibility to make decisions and take action quickly. No unnecessary red tape. Got an out-of-the-box idea? You'll have the autonomy to go ahead and try things that you might not be able to at other companies.

Pharmacy Technicians in our Patient Care Center of Excellence may hold multiple duties to ensure ExactCare’s patients receive quality care out of their pharmacy services. Experience

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: EST Business Hours

About the Role

Pavago is seeking a passionate and proactive Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing recruitment team. This role plays a critical part in identifying, attracting, and hiring exceptional talent for a diverse range of client positions across multiple industries.

This is more than just sourcing resumes—you will own the recruitment lifecycle from job posting through candidate presentation while delivering an outstanding experience for both candidates and clients. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy connecting great talent with exciting opportunities, and take pride in building strong hiring pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Candidate Sourcing & Recruitment

  • Create and publish engaging job postings across multiple hiring platforms.
  • Source high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
  • Review applications and conduct initial candidate screenings.
  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
  • Identify passive candidates through proactive sourcing strategies.

Candidate Assessment & Interviewing

  • Conduct structured interviews to evaluate candidates' technical skills, communication abilities, and cultural fit.
  • Assess candidate suitability based on client requirements.
  • Prepare comprehensive interview evaluations and hiring recommendations.
  • Present shortlisted candidates to clients with detailed profiles highlighting their strengths and qualifications.

Interview Coordination

  • Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
  • Manage interview scheduling and ensure a smooth recruitment experience.
  • Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout every stage of the hiring process.
  • Provide timely updates and feedback whenever possible.

Client Collaboration

  • Develop a strong understanding of each client's hiring requirements, business goals, and company culture.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to refine candidate profiles and hiring strategies.
  • Deliver exceptional client service by presenting highly qualified candidates efficiently.

Recruitment Operations

  • Maintain accurate candidate records within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Keep recruitment pipelines organized and up to date.
  • Support onboarding activities to ensure a seamless transition for successful candidates.
  • Continuously improve recruitment workflows and sourcing strategies.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy connecting talented people with great career opportunities.
  • You are highly organized and can manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
  • You communicate confidently with candidates, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • You proactively solve recruitment challenges instead of waiting for direction.
  • You take ownership of your roles and consistently deliver results.
  • You thrive in a remote, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Previous experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or a similar hiring role.
  • Strong experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and networking.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Experience conducting structured candidate interviews.
  • Ability to evaluate candidate qualifications and cultural fit.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Experience coordinating multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms.
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools for remote interviews.
  • Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities.

Nice-to-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience recruiting for remote or international positions.
  • Experience working in a recruitment agency or staffing environment.
  • Knowledge of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
  • Experience recruiting across multiple industries and functional roles.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing active hiring priorities, responding to new applications, and sourcing candidates across multiple platforms. Throughout the day, you conduct candidate interviews, coordinate client interviews, communicate with hiring managers, and present qualified candidates for open positions.

You'll maintain ATS records, manage recruitment pipelines, support onboarding activities, and continuously build relationships with talented professionals for future opportunities.

Success in this role comes from consistently identifying high-quality talent, delivering an excellent candidate experience, and helping clients hire exceptional people.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Time-to-Fill
  • Quality of Candidates Submitted
  • Interview-to-Offer Ratio
  • Candidate Response Rate
  • Client Satisfaction
  • ATS Data Accuracy
  • Candidate Experience
  • Offer Acceptance Rate

You Are the Right Person If...

  • You enjoy building relationships with people.
  • You are naturally curious and know how to uncover great talent.
  • You can confidently assess candidates through structured interviews.
  • You stay organized even while managing multiple open roles.
  • You are proactive, resourceful, and accountable.
  • You enjoy working in a fast-moving recruitment environment.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Video Interview
  3. Final Team Interview
  4. Background & Reference Checks
  5. Offer Stage

This role owns the successful launch of Arcadium for newly signed heavy-duty truck, trailer, equipment, and bus franchise dealers, as well as the rollout of new functionality for existing customers. Arcadium’s primary product is a market-specific customer relationship management (CRM) platform built for how heavy-duty franchise dealers operate. The Implementation Specialist is responsible for on-time implementation, customer satisfaction, and platform utilization for each assigned implementation - assessing each dealership’s needs, configuring the platform to meet them, and training dealership teams on best-practice use so they see value from day one.

This role sits at the intersection of the customer, the product, and the internal teams that deliver it. The Implementation Specialist coordinates the contributions of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management to keep every implementation on track, and continuously looks for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of the implementation process, including recommending process and product changes. This is an individual contributor role reporting to Customer Success leadership; it requires strong project management, consultative, and training abilities, and up to 25% travel for on-site dealer implementations and training.

Key Responsibilities

    • Needs Assessment & Discovery: Lead structured needs assessments with dealer principals, general managers, and department leaders to document current workflows, lead and customer management processes, data, integrations, and goals across the dealership’s new and used sales, parts, and service departments.
    • System Configuration: Translate assessment findings into a configuration plan and set up the Arcadium platform - users, roles and permissions, rooftops and departments, workflows, lead sources, templates, data imports, and integrations - to fit each dealership’s operations and Arcadium best practices.
    • Implementation Project Management: Own each implementation from kickoff through go-live, building and maintaining the project plan, milestones, and timeline; managing risks and dependencies; and keeping customer stakeholders and internal teams informed of status.
    • Training & Best-Practice Adoption: Deliver role-based training, remotely and on site, to dealership users and leadership, focused on best-practice use of the platform so teams adopt it quickly and consistently.
    • New Functionality for Existing Customers: Plan and implement new products, features, and expanded use - such as additional rooftops, departments, or modules - for existing customers, partnering with Account Managers and Sales to drive adoption and utilization.
    • Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate the activities of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management that contribute to each implementation - scoping requests, tracking deliverables, escalating blockers, and ensuring a clean handoff to Account Management after go-live.
    • Process & Product Improvement: Identify recurring issues, bottlenecks, and gaps in the implementation process and recommend process, tooling, and product changes that improve quality, shorten time-to-value, and increase efficiency.
    • Field Engagement: Travel up to 25% to conduct on-site activities at dealer locations, and participate in company-sponsored and industry events such as dealer association meetings and trade shows.
    • Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate, real-time implementation status, configuration records, training completion, and customer feedback within the company CRM system, and contribute to implementation playbooks, templates, and training materials.
    • Market Expertise: Develop deep expertise in the Arcadium platform and our full portfolio of solutions and share information and context internally - including customer feedback regarding dealership operations and customer needs.

About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team

CookUnity B2B is one of the company's fastest-growing divisions, scaling across four verticals — Bulk, Smart Fridge, Healthcare, and Partnership — with a bold H2 2026 north star of $44M in revenue and 120% retention rate.

Our engineering mission is equally ambitious: converge two acquired platforms into a single CookUnity codebase. B2B is the clearest example of that journey in the company — two legacy stacks, two acquired companies, converging into one. It's a high-ownership environment where engineers build at the intersection of logistics, IoT, and consumer software, with computer vision and AI-driven ordering systems already on the near-term roadmap.

If you thrive on hard problems, real business impact, and a small team where your work ships immediately — this is the role for you.

The Role

  • Lead the design and implementation of full-stack features across our B2B platform, working directly with product and operations leadership.
  • Drive the convergence of multiple legacy stacks into the core CookUnity codebase, making key architectural decisions along the way.
  • Automate and simplify operationally complex processes — from smart fridge inventory management to healthcare meal delivery workflows.
  • Maintain and scale our AWS infrastructure to support rapid vertical growth.
  • Mentor engineers across the team and contribute to raising the technical bar.
  • Be hands-on and build products used by thousands of corporate customers from day one.

Our Current Stack:

Languages: Java, JavaScript, TypeScript

Frameworks: ReactJS, NestJS

Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, MySQL

Methodology: Agile / Service-Oriented Architecture

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the platform is scalable, reliable, and efficient across all B2B verticals.

  • Own the design and implementation of platform features within our JavaScript/Java stack that engage customers and drive meaningful business outcomes.
  • Iterate on new and existing features to improve user experience, performance, and reliability.

  • Partner with Product, Operations, CX, and other teams to continuously refine and improve our platform in an agile environment.
  • Support the on-call rotation to help the business run 24/7
  • Contribute to documentation, deployment processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.

AI Usage & Engineering Excellence

At CookUnity B2B, AI is not a buzzword — it's part of how we build. We expect our engineers to actively integrate AI tools into their daily workflow to move faster and build better.

Expected (day-to-day):

  • Use AI-powered coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude / Codex) to accelerate development, code reviews, and debugging.
  • Apply AI to automate repetitive engineering tasks — test generation, boilerplate, documentation, and internal tooling.
  • Leverage AI assistants to explore architectural trade-offs, prototype quickly, and improve code quality.
  • Stay current on AI tooling best practices and share learnings with the team.

Nice to have (leadership signal):

  • Experience building AI-powered product features (e.g., smart recommendations, automated ordering, anomaly detection).
  • Ability to evaluate and introduce new AI tools or frameworks to the team, establishing best practices and adoption playbooks.
  • Prior work integrating LLM-based workflows, automation pipelines, or agentic tooling into production systems.

  • Strong proficiency with NodeJS / NestJS, ReactJS, AWS, and MySQL (or equivalent relational databases).
  • Experience with Java in a production environment.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented architecture, and API design.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken) — we're a distributed, international team.

Preferred Requirements

  • Comfortable working in a startup environment where priorities shift and ownership is broad.
  • Experience with observability tools (e.g., Datadog), infrastructure-as-code, or platform migrations.

Job Title: Patient Support Rep - Per Diem (PST Hours)

Department: Clinical and Service Operations

Location: Remote

About Podimetrics:

Founded in 2011, Podimetrics set out on a mission to improve patient lives through early detection and prevention of diabetic foot ulcers, the leading cause of lower limb amputations. Podimetrics has since evolved to become a rapidly growing virtual care management company with advanced technology and patient-centered services.

Today, Podimetrics teams with and provides solutions to patients, payers and providers that alleviate the health and financial implications of diabetic foot complications in high-risk populations. We are a mission driven, financially responsible enterprise that enables patients to stand on their own feet and live more independent and fulfilling lives.

Core Values:

  1. Mission First: We are here to drive critical change, bring hope and compassionate care to those in great need.
  2. People Matter Most: We advance our mission by caring for our people (colleagues, patients, providers, customers and stockholders), treating them with kindness and respect.
  3. Courageous Action: We are driven to act and demand mutual accountability. We believe that missteps foster learning and iterative improvement.
  4. Healthy Debate: We commit to transparent discussion and resulting decisions. The very best decisions come from differing points of view, requiring good intentions, mutual trust and no ego.
  5. Deep Curiosity: We are always striving to learn more and do better. We question if the best we have ever done couldn’t be improved further.

Role Description:

The Patient Service Excellence Representative plays a key role in delivering a compassionate, patient-centered experience through our blended call center. This team member is responsible for engaging with patients via telephone as the first point of contact for patients and caregivers, ensuring that every interaction reflects empathy, clarity, trust, and excellence. Team members are responsible for fielding incoming calls, resolving non-clinical inquiries, coordinating support logistics, and conducting proactive outreach to re-engage patients and reduce barriers to care. Through their work, team members ensure patients receive timely support and remain engaged in our innovative monitoring programs.

Key Responsibilities:

Service Excellence

  • Deliver a patient-centered experience that reflects empathy, clarity, trust, and excellence in every interaction.
  • Demonstrate genuine care, emotional validation, active listening, and warmth with patients and team members.
  • Foster long-term patient engagement and loyalty through personalized service and proactive problem-solving and education.
  • Act as the voice of the patient by sharing feedback and insights to inform improvements in programs, processes, and technology.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with patients, caregivers, and internal teams to ensure continuity of care.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support seamless handoffs and a high-quality patient experience.
  • Contribute ideas and observations during team huddles and meetings to support continuous service improvement.

Workflow Execution

  • Manage inbound and outbound communications across multiple channels, including phone, SMS, and email.
  • Triage and resolve non-clinical inquiries, escalating or transferring as appropriate to ensure timely support.
  • Provide logistical, technical, and administrative support, including troubleshooting, and coordinating services like UPS pickups.
  • Complete all documentation accurately and within required timelines to maintain service-level standards.
  • Maintain reliable remote connectivity and demonstrate the ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues independently to ensure uninterrupted workflow and patient support.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Communicate clearly with peers, leads, and managers to ensure continuity of care and seamless handoffs.
  • Contribute insights during huddles or team meetings to support service excellence

Quality & Performance Monitoring

  • Meet or exceed QA standards, productivity goals, and patient experience expectations.
  • Participate in peer reviews, audits, and improvement initiatives.

Qualifications:

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or higher preferred.
  • Call center background preferred, especially with remote work exposure.
  • Experience in patient or customer engagement.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to multitask, stay organized, and work independently
  • Typing speed of at least 40 words per minute

Preferred

  • Availability to work PST hours or 12pm-8pm EST shifts
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Saturday availability
  • Prior experience in healthcare, remote patient monitoring, or medical device onboarding.
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as call volume, activation rates, and conversion cycles.

Critical Competencies:

  • Compassionate Communication
  • Attention to Detail & Active Listening
  • Adaptability in Changing Workflows
  • Service Recovery & Professionalism
  • Enthusiasm & Work Ethic

Benefits:

  • Base Pay: $28/hour

  • 401k

• Location: Remote, based in Latin America, remote role for Colombia, Mexico and Argentina candidates

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant who can lead teams, work directly with U.S.-based clients, and improve accounting processes and systems. This client-facing leadership role requires technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, proactive communication and strong relationship management.

You will coordinate people and deliverables, review accounting work and contribute practical improvements through automation and appropriate AI tools. Prior hands-on accounting experience with U.S.-based clients or businesses is required.

Company overview

VargasAndrews is an international professional services firm specializing in business transformations and turnarounds. We support business owners through accounting, finance and business improvement services, with a vision to become an international market leader in business transformations.

Our values:

Teamwork & Camaraderie; Hiring & Developing the Best; Agility & Lean Thinking; Customer Obsession; Curiosity & Systemization; Ownership & Accountability.

Essential functions

40% - Senior accounting work: manage the full accounting cycle (Order to Cash, Procurement to Pay, Record to Report), financial reporting, budget preparation, variance analysis, payroll oversight, and complex reconciliations across multiple client accounts.

30% - Client engagement and team leadership: act as primary client point of contact, lead team task distribution, conduct review meetings, and ensure delivery quality and on-time completion.

20% - Review, quality control, and mentoring: review and approve work of Junior and Intermediate Accountants, conduct onboarding and training of new hires, and support recruitment activities.

10% - Process improvement and innovation: design and implement accounting SOPs, drive automation and AI-tool adoption, and coordinate strategic improvement initiatives with the Fractional Controller.

Qualifications and professional credentials

Education and mandatory professional status

Bachelor of Science in Accountancy, or a recognized local university degree in Accounting or Public Accountancy that qualifies the holder for the relevant professional accounting credential. A general business or finance degree alone does not meet this requirement.

Candidates must hold the relevant current professional public-accounting certification, license or registration in good standing. A degree alone, an examination pass without the required professional status, or experience working under a CPA is insufficient.

Required professional credential by Country

Mexico - Contador Público qualification and professional license (cédula profesional), together with current Contador Público Certificado (CPC) certification issued by IMCP.

Colombia - Contador Público qualification and valid Tarjeta Profesional issued by the Junta Central de Contadores (JCC), with professional status in good standing.

Argentina- Contador Público qualification and active matrícula with the relevant Consejo Profesional de Ciencias Económicas, in good standing.

Applicants must identify the credential, issuing authority, jurisdiction and registration or license number. Credentials will be verified before engagement. Candidates from other LATAM countries must hold the corresponding recognized public-accounting credential, subject to verification.

An active U.S. CPA license is an additional advantage. It does not replace any locally required authorization. CMA certification is also an advantage and does not replace the mandatory public-accounting credential.

Experience and capabilities

  • 5 to 7 years as a Senior Accountant or in a similar leadership role, preferably in an outsourced or international setup. Prior accounting delivery for U.S.-based clients or businesses is mandatory.
  • Solid knowledge of U.S. GAAP, IFRS, applicable tax laws and reporting standards.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, including the ability to manage client relationships and explain complex accounting concepts clearly.
  • Strong leadership, mentoring and review skills, with accountability for quality and delivery.
  • A meticulous approach to problem-solving, reviewing work and maintaining accurate records.
  • Proven ability to manage tight deadlines, multiple priorities and team workloads in a demanding environment.
  • Experience in cost accounting is an advantage. Experience using AI-driven tools or systems is highly desirable.
  • Ability to align availability with California local time and use Hubstaff as required for the engagement.

Scope of services and delivery standards

The following service areas and KPIs retain the existing RCFO engagement framework for the Senior Accountant I role.

Leadership and client management

  • Lead and act as the primary point of contact for clients, addressing inquiries, concerns, and requests promptly and effectively.
  • Facilitate meetings, presentations, and discussions to deepen client understanding and satisfaction.
  • Monitor client satisfaction and feedback, taking proactive measures to address issues and enhance the overall client experience.
  • Create detailed client project plans, timelines, and schedules to ensure timely completion of all deliverables.
  • Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members, providing guidance and support as needed.
  • Conduct regular project meetings to review status, discuss challenges, and make necessary adjustments.

Accounts Receivable

  • Reconciliation of customer invoices with the accounting system and bank payments/deposits received.
  • Preparation and submission of monthly invoices to clients no later than the agreed deadline (as applicable).
  • Ensure customer payments are recorded at most 1 day from receipt of payment.
  • Consistent monitoring and follow-through of customer payments, especially invoices more than 30 days past due.
  • Ensure that AR Aging reports are delivered to clients on a weekly basis and that escalation SOPs are followed as required.

Bank Reconciliation

  • Daily checking of the bank statement and daily recording of bank transactions in the client's accounting system.
  • Reconcile bank statement to book statement at most 2 days from the previous month-end.

Accounts Payable

  • Ensure all payments are properly approved and substantiated with supporting documents.
  • Ensure all Purchase Orders are duly approved by the Board.
  • Send AP Aging Report with notes for important payables.
  • Weekly monitoring of AP Aging and prompt reporting of any inconsistencies or new transactions to the Fractional Controller.

Senior accounting work continued

Payments to Employees and Contractors

  • Prepare the manual Pay Report on salaries and fees paid to employees and contractors within at most 2 days from the end of the payment cut-off period.
  • Record detailed payroll expenses no later than 2 days after the end of the payment period, with journal entries referencing the Pay Report.
  • Record payments to employees and contractors no later than 2 days from the payment period.

General Accounts

  • Accrue revenues and expenses for the month as needed.
  • Reverse accrued revenues and expenses for the month as needed.
  • Record prepayments and adjust as needed.
  • Review, record, and adjust other accounts as needed.

Financial Statement Closing Process

About Brello Health

Brello Health is AHG's direct-to-consumer women's telehealth brand, delivering personalized, outcomes-driven care to patients nationwide. Position Overview

This is a high-trust, high-leverage role supporting the Chief Executive Officer of Brello Health. The CEO's stakeholders span the Brello leadership team, clinical and commercial operators, marketing and growth partners, and the broader Allia Health Group executive team, all competing for the same finite calendar.

Your job is to make that work. You will control access to the CEO's time, decide what reaches her/him and what does not, keep the leadership team and its commitments moving, and ensure that nothing important falls through the cracks as Brello scales.

This role suits someone who is comfortable saying no on behalf of an executive, who moves before being asked, and who wants to grow their scope over time.

Key Responsibilities

Gatekeeping and Access

  • Own the CEO's calendar end to end, including scheduling, prioritization, conflict resolution, and rescheduling

  • Serve as a trusted sounding board for the CEO, offering candid, well-reasoned perspectives on operational, organizational, and business matters
  • Apply executive-level judgment to resolve issues independently when appropriate, and know when a decision must go back to the CEO

Team Cadence and Follow-Through

  • Run the operating rhythm of the leadership team, including agendas, pre-reads, structured notes, and action items with named owners and dates
  • Chase commitments to completion, including with people who do not report to you
  • Maintain project trackers, documentation, and status views for brand initiatives
  • Support OKR tracking and quarterly planning rhythms for Brello Health

Business Operations and Reporting

  • Support preparation of board materials, investor updates, and AHG corporate reporting on the CEO's behalf

  • Maintain a clean record of key decisions, approvals, and open items across the business
  • Assist with vendor research, tooling evaluations, and renewal calendars

  • 10+ years supporting a C-level or senior executive, ideally in healthcare, consumer, or a high-growth startup, with a track record of operating independently rather than task by task (exceptional candidates with less experience will be considered)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Outstanding organizational discipline, attention to detail, and follow-through under shifting priorities
  • High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and a proven record of handling highly confidential business, commercial, and personnel information with absolute discretion
  • Strong, advanced-level proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and building trackers and reports), plus fluency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and modern project management tools
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini) in daily work to draft, summarize, research, and automate routine tasks

Your First 90 Days

This role is designed to expand. As trust is established, the scope broadens into deeper involvement in planning, cross-functional programs, and independent ownership of workstreams on behalf of Brello Health. Location and Work Setup

jobs.excerpt: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Check out this Loom video for more details: We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

Responsible for the Project Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Contract(s) schedule and all aspects of the Progress Measurement System. This includes development, maintainence, monitoring, controlling and integration of the EPC schedule(s) including verification and reporting in addition to ensuring that all activities comply with standardized processes and are delivered to the highest possible standards.

Key Job Accountabilities

  1. Reviews project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule for stewardship purposes.
  2. Advises project management of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provides guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends. Assists Business Manager/Head in developing and reviewing schedule corrective actions and recovery plans, and verifies needed actions/plans are implemented.
  3. Monitors and appraises the performance of the Contractor compared to agreed control plans in the areas of progress and schedule control.
  1. Reviews and checks Contractor progress reports for accuracy of progress measurement. Verifies reviews and endorses claimed progress reported by the Contractor.
  2. Reviews, monitors and control the EPC Contractors schedules for all project activities for logic, level of detail, interfaces, etc (e.g., Level 3, Level 4, short-term look-ahead schedules).
  3. Reviews Contractor main subcontractor schedules and ensures that they have been correctly integrated into the overall EPC schedules.
  4. Reviews Contractors vendors and suppliers for both critical equipment and bulks and ensures that they have been correctly integrated into the overall EPC schedules.
  5. Reviews and endorses schedule and progress baselines and forecast prepared by the Contractor.
  6. Reviews schedule basis of Contractor change proposals - reviews and endorses changes with regards to schedule and progress impact.
  7. Supports Project Management with ongoing project schedule and progress analysis, reporting and forecasting activities.
  8. Develops and maintains project schedules and ensuring that these products reflect the approved project design/execution scope.
  9. Analyzes schedule trends, develop and review schedule forecasts.
  10. Conducts periodic meetings with the Contractor to review progress/activities and report on the status of the project to management.
  11. Provides overall project schedule, progress measurement, and change management expertise to the PMT.
  12. Reviews Contractor project control procedures (home office and field control procedures) to ensure that requirements are met.
  13. Ensures that the schedule control and progress procedures are executed by the Contractor to monitor its schedule control activities and progress reporting.
  14. Reviews Contractors schedules. Continually verifies contractors schedules for logical links, durations and overall achievability
  15. Reviews and checks Contractor progress reports for accuracy of progress measurement. Verifies reviews and endorses claimed progress reported by Contractor.
  16. Analyzes the planned quantity metrics projections for all disciplines (e.g. Piping, Civil, Electrical, etc.). Monitors actual metrics quantities completed against planned.
  17. Prepares and compiles Weekly and Monthly Reports (schedule & progress) input to Major Projects Reports.
  18. Responds to ad hoc requests from Business Head and Management related to scheduling and reporting, including development of progress metrics, and/or key performance indicators.
  19. Participates in gathering and recording Lessons Learned for the project that relate to progress and schedule areas.
  20. Works effectively within established policies and procedures, and participates in the further development of these to meet changing needs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in related subject or equivalent exeprience.

Knowledge and/or Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years experience in project scheduling and controls for EPC oil and gas facilities capital projects / operating companies
  • Thorough and extensive knowledge of project controls principles, theories, and concepts.
  • At least five (5) years site/field scheduling experience.
  • Experience developing work methods in accordance to established Company policies, directives from Management, schedules and professional engineering standards.
  • Ability to adapt to tight deadlines, heavy workloads, and frequent changes in priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to read, write, and speak fluent English.
  • Able to work within a defined role with limited supervision.
  • Willing and able to travel as required.

jobs.excerpt: At Scalable. co, we help entrepreneurs build businesses that run and grow without them so they can achieve their ideal exit without sacrificing their soul in the process.
jobs.description:
At Scalable.co, we help entrepreneurs build businesses that run and grow without them so they can achieve their ideal exit without sacrificing their soul in the process.

As a Scalable Business Advisor (SBA), you’ll guide a portfolio of 75–90 founders, CEOs, and executives through proven systems that help them scale their companies. You won’t be a "guru" or therapist; you’ll be a strategic facilitator and accountability partner helping business owners implement, execute, and scale.

Using our proprietary tools, frameworks, and planning rhythms, you’ll help founders stay focused, make better decisions, and build the infrastructure needed to grow with less chaos and more clarity.

This is a full-time, remote role that’s ideal for someone who loves entrepreneurs, thrives on results, and finds fulfillment in helping companies grow.

What You’ll Do

  • Work one-on-one with 75–90 founders, CEOs, and executives, helping them apply Scalable’s frameworks to solve operational bottlenecks
  • Facilitate bi-weekly implementation sessions, helping customize and install the Scalable Operating System™ into our client's companies during the 16-week Get Scalable Accelerator™
  • Lead quarterly 90-Day Planning Sessions with clients, helping them identify their "next right thing" and leveraging our tools, resources, and community to support them in achieving their goals
  • Use questions, tools, and proven models to help clients gain clarity, make decisions, and get results
  • Drive results through structured accountability—following up, checking in, and pushing clients to stay on track
  • Track client progress and sentiment in the CRM (HubSpot), escalating risks and celebrating wins
  • Collaborate with Client Success and Program Leadership to ensure a seamless, high-touch client experience


What Success Looks Like:

  • 75%+ of clients renew after their initial engagement
  • 80%+ of assigned clients complete 90-Day Planning every quarter
  • Clients consistently make measurable progress towards or achieve their set goals and priorities
  • Clients feel challenged, supported, and energized after each session
  • Your book of business is well-managed and CRM data is up-to-date

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience running, scaling, leading, or advising entrepreneurial businesses
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills—especially in virtual, one-on-one settings
  • Familiarity with business operating systems like Scalable OS, EOS, Scaling Up, OKRs, or similar
  • Based in a U.S. or Canadian time zone with availability during standard business hours
  • Comfortable using CRM software (HubSpot preferred), Slack, and Zoom


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience facilitating structured programs or planning sessions
  • Prior experience in "high-ticket" coaching, advisory, or mastermind programs
  • Familiarity with multiple business types and models

Benefits

Full-Time employees are eligible for health and welfare benefits.

  • Competitive Salary + Performance-Based Compensation
  • Health, Dental, + Vision Insurance
  • HSA plan with Company Matching (for eligible HDHP enrollees)
  • Company-Paid Telemedicine Plan
  • Company-Paid Mental Wellness, Financial Wellness, + Legal Counseling services
  • Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401K Plan with Company Matching
  • Parental leave
  • and more...


About The Scalable Company:

At The Scalable Company (), we’re building an ecosystem of tools and services any entrepreneur can plug into to scale their companies and themselves. By combining best-in-class models and frameworks with access to peer masterminds and world-class mentors, we increase the odds of a successful outcome for entrepreneurs, their families, and their teams and customers.

We deliver our flagship 16-week program, the Get Scalable Accelerator, as well two different flagship 12-month backend programs, the Scale & Exit Accelerator and Founders Board Mastermind – each of which are designed for bootstrapped entrepreneurs at different stages of their business. We also host an annual event, Get Scalable Live, that brings together entrepreneurs from all over the world to network and spend valuable time working above their business.

You can read more about our company and our mission by reading our manifesto, here.

Our Core Values:

1. We love entrepreneurs. Entrepreneurs are innovators and job creators. They take risks that most people would call “crazy,” and the best ones (the ones we get to work with) take all the blame when things go wrong and give away all the credit when things go right. We believe it’s an honor and a privilege to play a small role in helping them make a “dent” in their corner of the universe. (NOTE: If we get this one right, we can get a lot of other things wrong.)

2. We are “batteries included.” While we love praise and reward, neither are required for us to do our best work. We show up and bring our best because that’s who we are, not because someone else “motivated” or “inspired” us to act that way.

3. We raise the bar. Our past successes don't define us any more than our past failures, which is why we work to get a little better every day. We have high standards for ourselves and our team, we never stop learning, and when we have the opportunity to hire someone smarter and more talented than us...WE DO IT!

4. We do the dishes. No work is beneath us if it serves our teammates and our customers.

5. We seek the why. "That's how we've always done it..." is NEVER an acceptable response. Whether things go right or things go wrong, we always ask, “Why?”


Why You Might Be Excited About Us

  • Like us, you believe entrepreneurs make the world a better place, and you’re excited about our mission to eradicate entrepreneurial imposter syndrome and help more small businesses succeed.
  • Like us, you like the idea of working remotely and having more flexibility in your schedule.
  • Like us, you enjoy driving new projects and making direct contributions to the company’s success and mission.
  • Like us, you crave the idea of “owning a number” and having objective proof of your value to the team.
  • Like us, you enjoy having access to some of the smartest, most successful, (and even famous) entrepreneurs and business owners in the world. (At the end of the day, our mutant power is community-building, so you never know who’s going to show up at our meetings and events.)


Why You Might NOT Be Excited About Us

  • We’re fairly small (~25 people), so if you like more hierarchy and levels of management in a bigger company, this role isn’t for you.
  • We don’t have it all figured out. As a bootstrapped, entrepreneurial-driven startup, there are many areas of the company where we’re still “building the rocket on the way up.” So, if you require a tested and proven playbook to perform every aspect of your job, then this probably isn’t the place for you.
  • We work really, really hard. Everyone on the team is extremely mission-driven, and works incredibly hard to achieve our “comfortably-uncomfortable” goals. While we DON’T believe in working weekends or pulling “all-nighters” as a normal course of business, if you want a cushy, 40-hour per week job, you probably won’t like it here.
  • We change our minds, pivot fast, and embrace change when change is needed. We aren’t flakes, nor do we seek chaos for chaos’ sake. But we WILL shift projects and priorities when presented with new data, so, again, if you need to work at a company that “has it all figured out,” we’re not the place for you.
  • We don’t micro-manage. This is not the kind of job where you show up and we tell you exactly what to do every day. We need people who can manage their own calendar and who aren’t afraid to Google something if they don’t know how to do it. In other words, if you need to know EXACTLY what you will be doing every hour of the day, week over week, we’re probably not a good fit.


The Scalable Company provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, The Scalable Company complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a seasoned technology executive with 12+ years of experience in solution architecture, technical consulting, systems integration, VAR, MSP, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or related environments, including significant leadership experience overseeing geographically distributed pre-sales or technical organizations. This leader combines broad technical fluency across enterprise infrastructure, networking, security, cloud, data center, professional services, managed services, and emerging technologies with the strategic judgment needed to translate complex capabilities into compelling business outcomes.

About The Role

The Vice President of Client Solution Architects (CSA) is responsible for the strategy, leadership, and national execution of Myriad360's Client Solution Architect organization.

This role leads the CSA Directors and the broader team of Client Solution Architects and Security Client Solution Architects across the country, ensuring the organization operates as a consistent, scalable technical pursuit function aligned with Myriad360's growth strategy.

The VP of CSAs is accountable for ensuring CSAs serve as strategic technical counterparts to the Sales organization—engaging early in client opportunities, leading cross-practice discovery, identifying broader business and technology needs, orchestrating the appropriate specialists and practices, and helping shape solutions that deliver meaningful client outcomes.

This leader will build the systems, standards, talent, enablement, and governance necessary to scale the CSA model nationally while maintaining strong alignment across Sales, Pre-Sales, Professional Services, Managed Services, Field Services, Practices, Delivery, and strategic technology partners.

The VP of Client Solution Architects is ultimately responsible for making Myriad360's breadth of technical and services capability usable in the field—translating that breadth into better client conversations, larger opportunities, stronger solution quality, and improved client outcomes.

Must be based in the United States.

Other responsibilities include:

National CSA Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the vision, strategy, operating model, and execution of the national CSA and Security CSA organization.
  • Lead and develop CSA Directors, establishing clear expectations, accountability, leadership standards, and succession plans.
  • Ensure consistent execution of the CSA model across regions while allowing appropriate flexibility based on client and market needs.
  • Establish organizational structure, coverage models, capacity planning, and hiring strategy as the business scales.
  • Serve as the executive advocate for the CSA organization across Myriad360 leadership.
  • Build a culture centered on curiosity, collaboration, accountability, technical credibility, and client outcomes.

Sales Partnership & Opportunity Creation

  • Ensure CSAs operate as strategic technical counterparts to Account Executives and become involved early in qualified opportunities.
  • Establish clear engagement models and expectations between Sales and the CSA organization.
  • Develop the CSA organization beyond reactive opportunity support toward proactive opportunity identification and creation.
  • Help CSAs recognize client triggers, technology transitions, operational challenges, and business initiatives that can create new opportunities.
  • Drive stronger technical account planning and strategic conversations within key accounts.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to improve technical coverage, pursuit strategy, and account penetration.

Cross-Practice Discovery & Solution Orchestration

  • Ensure CSAs lead broad discovery before solutions are narrowed to individual technologies or practices.
  • Drive a consistent methodology for identifying opportunities across Networking, Data Center, Security, Cloud, Platform Solutions, AI, Professional Services, Managed Services, and Field Services.
  • Ensure the appropriate Specialists, Practice resources, Services teams, and strategic partners are engaged at the right point in the opportunity lifecycle.
  • Prevent technical pursuits from becoming isolated within individual practices or technology domains.
  • Reinforce that CSAs do not need to be the deepest expert in every technology—they must know how to identify the need and orchestrate the right expertise.

Pursuit Quality & Governance

  • Establish standards for CSA engagement in strategic, complex, multi-practice, and high-value opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales, Practice, Professional Services, and Delivery leadership to improve opportunity qualification and solution readiness.
  • Establish appropriate technical design and pursuit-review governance without creating unnecessary friction or bureaucracy.
  • Ensure risks, dependencies, assumptions, services requirements, and cross-practice opportunities are identified early.
  • Improve the quality of opportunity handoffs from Pre-Sales into Professional Services, Managed Services, and Delivery.

Services & Lifecycle Alignment

  • Ensure CSAs think beyond product architecture and consider the complete client lifecycle:
    • Discover → Advise → Design → Deploy → Adopt → Operate → Optimize
  • Drive earlier identification and attachment of Professional Services, Managed Services, Field Services, advisory, and lifecycle opportunities.
  • Partner with Services leadership to ensure service requirements are identified during discovery rather than added after the technical solution has already been designed.
  • Help position Myriad360 as an accountable technology partner capable of supporting clients across the entire lifecycle.

Technical Strategy & Emerging Technologies

  • Ensure the CSA organization stays ahead of major technology transitions affecting Myriad360 clients.
  • Partner with Practice and technology leadership to determine which capabilities CSAs need to understand versus where specialist expertise should be engaged.
  • Drive awareness and opportunity creation around emerging areas including AI infrastructure, Enterprise AI, RAG and agentic AI, automation, observability, hybrid cloud, cybersecurity, platform engineering, and modern data center architectures.
  • Translate emerging technology trends into practical client conversations and repeatable opportunity plays.

Enablement & Talent Development

  • Own the national CSA enablement strategy and certification program.
  • Establish clear technical, business, discovery, communication, and leadership expectations for CSA progression.
  • Partner with Practice leaders, OEMs, and internal experts to maintain a structured enablement cadence.
  • Develop CSA Directors into strong people leaders capable of coaching rather than simply managing activity.
  • Build career paths and succession plans across CSA, Security CSA, leadership, specialist, and broader technical roles.
  • Create mechanisms for sharing successful pursuits, architectures, client conversations, and lessons learned across the national organization.

OEM & Partner Alignment

  • Build strong relationships with strategic technology partners and their engineering leadership.
  • Ensure the CSA organization understands Myriad360's strategic OEM priorities and can appropriately identify opportunities across the partner ecosystem.
  • Partner with Alliances and Practice leadership on enablement, certifications, joint go-to-market initiatives, and strategic pursuits.
  • Help strengthen field-level relationships between Myriad360 CSAs and OEM technical teams.

One Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Actively promote a One Team operating model across Sales, Pre-Sales, Professional Services, Managed Services, PMO, and Delivery.
  • Reinforce direct communication, shared accountability, empathy, and a client-first mindset rather than functional or organizational boundaries.
  • Build trust across teams and address friction through clear expectations, transparent communication, and shared problem solving.
  • Model the behavior expected of the organization by seeking to understand before assigning blame and by resolving issues directly rather than through side conversations.
  • Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section.
  • Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Business Impact & Measurement

The VP should establish a meaningful set of performance indicators that demonstrate the impact of the CSA organization without creating an activity-tracking culture or turning the CSA organization into a quota-carrying overlay sales team.

  • Influenced pipeline and opportunity creation
  • CSA engagement in qualified strategic opportunities
  • Cross-practice discovery and attach
  • Professional Services and Managed Services attach
  • Expansion of existing client opportunities
  • Deal quality and solution readiness
  • Strategic account penetration
  • Sales and Practice alignment
  • Client engagement and executive access
  • Win/loss insights
  • Technical certifications and capability development
  • CSA talent development and retention

The fundamental measure of success is whether the CSA organization helps Myriad360 get involved earlier, discover more, create larger opportunities, improve solution quality, and deliver better client outcomes.

Leadership Expectations

  • Lead through the CSA Directors rather than becoming the technical escalation point for every opportunity.
  • Build systems and leaders that allow the organization to scale.
  • Think strategically while creating operating mechanisms that drive consistent execution.
  • Build trust across Sales, Engineering, Practices, Services, PMO, and Delivery.
  • Challenge teams to think beyond the immediate technology request.
  • Communicate complex technical and business concepts clearly to executives and technical audiences.
  • Create accountability without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
  • Maintain composure and sound judgment in high-pressure client and internal situations.
  • Model curiosity, empathy, collaboration, and a client-first mindset.

Desired skills and experience:

  • 12+ years of experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, systems integration, VAR, MSP, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or related technology organizations.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience within Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Sales Engineering, technical consulting, or similar functions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed technical organizations, preferably including managers or directors.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Sales leadership in complex enterprise technology pursuits.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking, security, cloud, data center, services, and emerging technology trends.
  • Experience building or scaling technical Pre-Sales organizations, operating models, enablement programs, or governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success influencing complex opportunities involving multiple technical disciplines and stakeholders.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience developing leaders and building high-performing technical teams.
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes and strategic client conversations.
  • Experience within a national technology integrator, VAR, systems integrator, consulting organization, or MSP.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise and strategic accounts.
  • Familiarity with Professional Services and Managed Services business models.
  • Experience working across multiple strategic OEM ecosystems.
  • Experience with technical account planning and proactive opportunity development.

Job Responsibilities

Job responsibilities
• Provides advice and subject matter expertise for the development of the monitoring strategy required for the project and where required, advises the project team on any updates to the monitoring strategy during the study based on risks.
• Works with cross-functional leads to understand complex indications and risks and seeks input on risk mitigations. Provides guidance to cross-functional leads to ensure consistency within programs, therapeutic areas and/or sponsors.

• Ensures PL transfers risks identified to the correct tracking system and supports ongoing cross-functional review of risks throughout the project.

Ensures Inspection Readiness for risk assessment and centralized monitoring scope.

• Strong analytical skills and well-developed understanding of statistical concepts.
• Well-developed therapeutic expertise.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Strong negotiation skills, organizational skills and problem-solving skills.
